```{r setUpDirectories, cache = TRUE}
projNumber <- "P697"
baseDir <- "/Users/tedwards/Documents/projects/P697_TEAseq_T1D_low_dose_IL2"
dataInputDir <- file.path(baseDir, "data/inputData")
plotDir <- file.path(baseDir, "figures")
dataOutputDir <- file.path(baseDir, "data/outputData")
dataDate <- "2026-02-10"
filenameSuffix <- paste0(projNumber, ".", dataDate)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Define pools and construct file paths for both Multi (GEX+HTO) and Arc (ATAC)
## P697 is a TEAseq project with two subprojects (P697-1 and P697-2), each with 4 pools.
## Multi flowcells contain GEX + HTO data (cellranger multi)
## Arc flowcells contain ATAC + GEX data (cellranger arc)
## Since GEX is identical between runs, we use Multi for GEX+HTO and Arc for ATAC only.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Base server path
serverBase <- "/Volumes/bioinformatics/pipeline/Illumina"

# Define flowcell paths for each subproject
flowcells <- list(
  `P697-1` = list(
    multi = list(
      flowcell = "251215_VH01513_82_AACYM3NHV",
      processed = "Project_P697-1Processed_bri_251218"
    ),
    arc = list(
      flowcell = "251216_VH00126_442_AACYV5KHV",
      processed = "Project_P697-1Processed_bri_251218"
    )
  ),
  `P697-2` = list(
    multi = list(
      flowcell = "260114_VH01513_87_222GFVGNX",
      processed = "Project_P697-2Processed_bri_260129"
    ),
    arc = list(
      flowcell = "260115_VH00126_446_AACYVCGHV",
      processed = "Project_P697-2Processed_bri_260129"
    )
  )
)

# Define all 8 pools across both subprojects
P697_pools <- tibble::tribble(
  ~subproject, ~pool,         ~multiPoolDir,  ~arcPoolDir,
  "P697-1",    "pool697-1_1", "pool697-1_1",  "pool697-1_1_arc",
  "P697-1",    "pool697-1_2", "pool697-1_2",  "pool697-1_2_arc",
  "P697-1",    "pool697-1_3", "pool697-1_3",  "pool697-1_3_arc",
  "P697-1",    "pool697-1_4", "pool697-1_4",  "pool697-1_4_arc",
  "P697-2",    "pool697-2_1", "pool697-2_1",  "pool697-2_1_arc",
  "P697-2",    "pool697-2_2", "pool697-2_2",  "pool697-2_2_arc",
  "P697-2",    "pool697-2_3", "pool697-2_3",  "pool697-2_3_arc",
  "P697-2",    "pool697-2_4", "pool697-2_4",  "pool697-2_4_arc"
)

# Construct full file paths for each pool
P697_files_df <- P697_pools %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Multi flowcell paths (GEX + HTO)
    # NOTE: Cell Ranger Multi outputs h5 matrices but NOT per_barcode_metrics.csv
    # in the per_sample_outs structure. Per-barcode metrics come from Arc pipeline.
    multiFlowcellPath = file.path(serverBase,
      flowcells[[subproject]]$multi$flowcell,
      flowcells[[subproject]]$multi$processed),
    multi_filtered_h5 = file.path(multiFlowcellPath, multiPoolDir,
      "outs", "per_sample_outs", multiPoolDir, "count",
      "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"),
    multi_raw_h5 = file.path(multiFlowcellPath,
      "outs", "multi", "count", "raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"),
    featureRefFile = file.path(multiFlowcellPath,
      paste0(multiPoolDir, "_featureReference.csv")),
    # Arc flowcell paths (ATAC + GEX metrics)
    # NOTE: Cell Ranger Arc per_barcode_metrics.csv contains BOTH GEX and ATAC metrics
    # because Arc is a multiome pipeline processing both modalities together
    arcFlowcellPath = file.path(serverBase,
      flowcells[[subproject]]$arc$flowcell,
      flowcells[[subproject]]$arc$processed),
    arc_filtered_h5 = file.path(arcFlowcellPath, arcPoolDir,
      "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"),
    arc_fragments = file.path(arcFlowcellPath, arcPoolDir,
      "outs", "atac_fragments.tsv.gz"),
    arc_peak_annotation = file.path(arcFlowcellPath, arcPoolDir,
      "outs", "atac_peak_annotation.tsv"),
    arc_per_barcode_metrics = file.path(arcFlowcellPath, arcPoolDir,
      "outs", "per_barcode_metrics.csv")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Vectors for downstream compatibility
P697_samplePools <- P697_files_df$pool
P697_subprojects <- P697_files_df$subproject

# Print summary of configured pools
cat("Configured", nrow(P697_files_df), "pools across",
  length(unique(P697_files_df$subproject)), "subprojects:\n")
for (sp in unique(P697_files_df$subproject)) {
  pools <- P697_files_df$pool[P697_files_df$subproject == sp]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %s\n", sp, paste(pools, collapse = ", ")))
}
```

```{r fragmentConversionUtility}
# Utility function to convert Cell Ranger Arc 2.x fragment files (6-column with strand)
# to Signac-compatible 5-column format (without strand) and index with tabix
# Required for full Signac functionality: TSS enrichment, footprinting, etc.
# IMPORTANT: Writes to project output directory, never modifies pipeline files

convertFragments6to5Column <- function(inputPath, outputPath) {
  # Convert Arc 2.x 6-column fragment files to Signac-compatible 5-column format.
  # Uses a streaming shell pipeline (zcat | cut | bgzip) to avoid loading the
  # entire fragment file into R memory. Fragment files can be 2-10+ GB; fread()
  # would require ~3x that in RAM for read + write + compression.
  # Cell Ranger output is already coordinate-sorted, so no re-sort is needed.

  cat(sprintf("Converting fragment file: %s\n", basename(inputPath)))
  cat(sprintf("  Output: %s\n", outputPath))

  indexPath <- paste0(outputPath, ".tbi")

  # Check if output and index already exist
  if (file.exists(outputPath) && file.exists(indexPath)) {
    cat("  Output and index already exist, skipping conversion\n")
    return(outputPath)
  }

  # Clean up any partial output from a previous failed run
  if (file.exists(outputPath)) file.remove(outputPath)
  if (file.exists(indexPath)) file.remove(indexPath)

  # --- Streaming conversion via shell pipeline ---
  # zcat handles .gz input; cut drops column 6 (strand); bgzip produces
  # block-gzipped output compatible with tabix indexing.
  # This never loads the file into R memory.
  hasBgzip <- nchar(Sys.which("bgzip")) > 0
  hasTabix <- nchar(Sys.which("tabix")) > 0

  if (hasBgzip && hasTabix) {
    cat("  Using streaming shell pipeline (zcat | cut | bgzip)...\n")
    cmd <- sprintf(
      "zcat '%s' | cut -f1-5 | bgzip -c > '%s'",
      inputPath, outputPath
    )
    exitCode <- system(cmd, ignore.stdout = TRUE)
    if (exitCode != 0) {
      stop(sprintf("Fragment conversion failed (exit code %d) for %s", exitCode, inputPath))
    }

    cat("  Creating tabix index...\n")
    exitCode <- system(sprintf("tabix -p bed '%s'", outputPath), ignore.stdout = TRUE)
    if (exitCode != 0) {
      stop(sprintf("Tabix indexing failed (exit code %d) for %s", exitCode, outputPath))
    }
  } else {
    # Fallback: use R-based conversion (higher RAM, but functional)
    cat("  bgzip/tabix not on PATH; falling back to R-based conversion...\n")
    cat("  WARNING: This will load the full fragment file into R memory\n")

    fragments <- data.table::fread(inputPath, header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
    fragments5col <- fragments[, 1:5]

    outputPathUncompressed <- sub("\\.gz$", "", outputPath)
    data.table::fwrite(fragments5col, file = outputPathUncompressed,
      sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE, compress = "none")
    cat(sprintf("  Converted %d fragments\n", nrow(fragments)))
    rm(fragments, fragments5col)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)

    Rsamtools::bgzip(outputPathUncompressed, dest = outputPath, overwrite = TRUE)
    file.remove(outputPathUncompressed)
    Rsamtools::indexTabix(outputPath, format = "bed")
  }

  cat(sprintf("  Fragment file indexed: %s\n", basename(indexPath)))
  return(outputPath)
}
```

```{r setHashtagNames}
## Read donor hashtag (HT) variable names from featureReference.csv files
## These files are located in the Multi flowcell directories and contain
## hashtag-to-donor mappings with format: id, name, read, pattern, sequence, feature_type

# Function to read hashtag info from featureReference.csv
getHashtagInfo <- function(featureRefPath) {
  if (!file.exists(featureRefPath)) {
    warning(paste("Feature reference file not found:", featureRefPath))
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- readr::read_csv(featureRefPath, show_col_types = FALSE)
  # Filter for Antibody Capture features (hashtags)
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(feature_type == "Antibody Capture") %>%
    dplyr::select(id, name, sequence)
}

# Build hashtag info for all pools
P697HashtagList <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(P697_files_df))) {
  poolName <- P697_files_df$pool[i]
  featureFile <- P697_files_df$featureRefFile[i]
  htInfo <- getHashtagInfo(featureFile)
  if (!is.null(htInfo)) {
    P697HashtagList[[poolName]] <- htInfo
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d hashtags - %s\n", poolName, nrow(htInfo),
      paste(htInfo$name, collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

cat("\nHashtag info loaded for", length(P697HashtagList), "pools\n")
```

```{r readGEXHTOFromMultiFlowcells}
## Read GEX + HTO data from Multi flowcells (cellranger multi output)
## Multi output structure: poolDir/outs/per_sample_outs/poolName/count/sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
## This h5 contains both "Gene Expression" and "Antibody Capture" (HTO) assays

cat("Reading GEX+HTO data from Multi flowcells...\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")

# Check which Multi h5 files exist
multiFilesExist <- file.exists(P697_files_df$multi_filtered_h5)
cat("Multi h5 files found:", sum(multiFilesExist), "of", nrow(P697_files_df), "\n\n")

if (any(!multiFilesExist)) {
  cat("Missing Multi h5 files:\n")
  for (i in which(!multiFilesExist)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %s\n", P697_files_df$pool[i], P697_files_df$multi_filtered_h5[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Initialize storage
gexObjects.tmp <- list()
htoObjects.tmp <- list()

# Read each pool's Multi h5 file
for (i in seq_len(nrow(P697_files_df))) {
  poolName <- P697_files_df$pool[i]
  subproject <- P697_files_df$subproject[i]
  h5Path <- P697_files_df$multi_filtered_h5[i]

  if (file.exists(h5Path)) {
    cat(sprintf("Reading %s (%s)...\n", poolName, subproject))
    cat(sprintf("  Path: %s\n", h5Path))

    h5_data <- Read10X_h5(h5Path)

    # Check available assays
    availableAssays <- names(h5_data)
    cat(sprintf("  Available assays: %s\n", paste(availableAssays, collapse = ", ")))

    # Extract Gene Expression
    if ("Gene Expression" %in% availableAssays) {
      gexObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- h5_data[["Gene Expression"]]
      cat(sprintf("  GEX: %d genes x %d cells\n",
        nrow(h5_data[["Gene Expression"]]), ncol(h5_data[["Gene Expression"]])))
    } else {
      warning(paste("No Gene Expression assay in", h5Path))
    }

    # Extract Antibody Capture (HTO)
    if ("Antibody Capture" %in% availableAssays) {
      htoObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- h5_data[["Antibody Capture"]]
      cat(sprintf("  HTO: %d hashtags x %d cells\n",
        nrow(h5_data[["Antibody Capture"]]), ncol(h5_data[["Antibody Capture"]])))
      cat(sprintf("  Hashtags: %s\n", paste(rownames(h5_data[["Antibody Capture"]]), collapse = ", ")))
    } else {
      warning(paste("No Antibody Capture assay in", h5Path))
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

cat(sprintf("Successfully loaded GEX data from %d pools\n", length(gexObjects.tmp)))
cat(sprintf("Successfully loaded HTO data from %d pools\n", length(htoObjects.tmp)))

# Create Seurat objects with GEX data
cat("\nCreating Seurat objects with GEX data...\n")
seuratObjects.tmp <- list()

for (poolName in names(gexObjects.tmp)) {
  gexMat <- gexObjects.tmp[[poolName]]
  seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = gexMat,
    min.features = 100,
    min.cells = 3,
    project = poolName
  )

  # Add HTO assay if available
  if (poolName %in% names(htoObjects.tmp)) {
    htoMat <- htoObjects.tmp[[poolName]]
    # Subset HTO matrix to cells in Seurat object
    commonCells <- intersect(colnames(seurat), colnames(htoMat))
    if (length(commonCells) > 0) {
      htoMat <- htoMat[, commonCells, drop = FALSE]
      seurat <- subset(seurat, cells = commonCells)
      seurat[["HT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = htoMat)
      cat(sprintf("  %s: Added HT assay with %d hashtags for %d cells\n",
        poolName, nrow(htoMat), ncol(htoMat)))
    }
  }

  seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat
}

# Print summary
cat("\nSeurat objects created:\n")
for (poolName in names(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]]
  assayNames <- names(seurat@assays)
  hasHT <- "HT" %in% assayNames
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d genes x %d cells, HT assay: %s\n",
    poolName, nrow(seurat), ncol(seurat), ifelse(hasHT, "yes", "no")))
}
```

```{r readATACFromArcFlowcells}
## Validate Arc flowcell paths and compute barcode overlap with Multi GEX.
## Peak matrices are NOT stored here — they are loaded on-demand during
## integration (integrateATACAssay) one pool at a time to limit RAM usage.
## Only file paths are recorded in atacInputs.tmp for downstream use.

cat("Reading ATAC metadata from Arc flowcells...\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")

# Check which Arc files exist
arcFilesExist <- file.exists(P697_files_df$arc_filtered_h5)
arcFragmentsExist <- file.exists(P697_files_df$arc_fragments)
cat("Arc h5 files found:", sum(arcFilesExist), "of", nrow(P697_files_df), "\n")
cat("Arc fragment files found:", sum(arcFragmentsExist), "of", nrow(P697_files_df), "\n\n")

# Store only paths — no peak matrices kept in memory
atacInputs.tmp <- list()
barcodeComparison <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(P697_files_df))) {
  poolName <- P697_files_df$pool[i]
  subproject <- P697_files_df$subproject[i]
  h5Path <- P697_files_df$arc_filtered_h5[i]
  fragPath <- P697_files_df$arc_fragments[i]

  if (!file.exists(h5Path)) next

  cat(sprintf("Checking ATAC for %s (%s)...\n", poolName, subproject))

  # Read h5 just to get barcodes and dimensions, then release
  h5_data <- Read10X_h5(h5Path)
  availableAssays <- names(h5_data)
  cat(sprintf("  Available assays: %s\n", paste(availableAssays, collapse = ", ")))

  if (!("Peaks" %in% availableAssays)) {
    cat("  No Peaks assay found, skipping\n\n")
    rm(h5_data)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    next
  }

  peakMat <- h5_data[["Peaks"]]
  nPeaks <- nrow(peakMat)
  arcBarcodes <- colnames(peakMat)
  nArc <- length(arcBarcodes)
  cat(sprintf("  Peaks: %d regions x %d cells\n", nPeaks, nArc))

  # Record paths for on-demand loading in integrateATACAssay
  atacInputs.tmp[[poolName]] <- list(
    arc_filtered_h5 = h5Path,
    arc_fragments = fragPath,
    nPeaks = nPeaks,
    nArcCells = nArc
  )

  # Barcode overlap with GEX (exact match first, then suffix-stripped diagnostic)
  if (poolName %in% names(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
    gexBarcodes <- colnames(seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]])
    nGEX <- length(gexBarcodes)

    # Exact matches (preferred)
    nExact <- length(intersect(gexBarcodes, arcBarcodes))

    # Suffix-stripped overlap (diagnostic only)
    gexBase <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", gexBarcodes)
    arcBase <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", arcBarcodes)
    nBaseShared <- sum(gexBase %in% arcBase)

    barcodeComparison[[poolName]] <- data.frame(
      pool = poolName,
      subproject = subproject,
      nGEX = nGEX,
      nArc = nArc,
      nExactMatch = nExact,
      nBaseMatch = nBaseShared,
      pctGEX_exact = round(100 * nExact / nGEX, 1),
      pctGEX_base = round(100 * nBaseShared / nGEX, 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    cat(sprintf("  Barcode overlap: %d exact (%.1f%%), %d suffix-stripped (%.1f%% of GEX)\n",
      nExact, 100 * nExact / nGEX, nBaseShared, 100 * nBaseShared / nGEX))
  }

  # Free peak matrix immediately — it will be re-read per-pool during integration
  rm(peakMat, h5_data)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}

# Summarize barcode comparison
cat("Barcode comparison summary (Multi GEX vs Arc ATAC):\n")
barcodeComparisonDf <- do.call(rbind, barcodeComparison)
print(barcodeComparisonDf, row.names = FALSE)

barcodeCompFile <- file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_BarcodeComparison_Multi_vs_Arc.xlsx"))
writexl::write_xlsx(barcodeComparisonDf, path = barcodeCompFile)
cat(sprintf("\nSaved barcode comparison table to: %s\n", barcodeCompFile))

cat(sprintf("\nATAC inputs configured for %d pools (peak data will be loaded on-demand)\n",
  length(atacInputs.tmp)))
```

```{r integrateATACAssay}
## Add ATAC as ChromatinAssay to Seurat objects (matched cells only).
##
## Design rationale (RAM):
##   - Peak matrices are loaded on-demand from atacInputs.tmp (paths only) and
##     freed immediately after the ChromatinAssay is built.
##   - The ATAC assay covers only the ~97% of cells with exact barcode matches
##     between Multi and Arc. We do NOT pad with empty columns for the ~3% of
##     GEX-only cells; that would roughly double column count for no analytical
##     benefit. The hasATAC metadata flag tracks which cells carry ATAC.
##   - Genome annotations are built once outside the loop.
##
## Fragment handling:
##   - Barcodes registered with CreateFragmentObject use GEX barcode names.
##     After merge() with add.cell.ids, Signac automatically prepends the pool
##     prefix to fragment cell lists, so downstream functions (TSSEnrichment,
##     NucleosomeSignal, etc.) continue to work.

cat("Integrating ATAC assay into Seurat objects...\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")

# Build genome annotation once (expensive; identical for all pools)
cat("Building hg38 genome annotations...\n")
annotations <- GetGRangesFromEnsDb(ensdb = EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86::EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
seqlevelsStyle(annotations) <- "UCSC"
genome(annotations) <- "hg38"

for (poolName in names(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]]

  if (!(poolName %in% names(atacInputs.tmp))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: No ATAC data available, skipping\n", poolName))
    seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- FALSE
    seurat[["hasGEX"]] <- TRUE
    seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat
    next
  }

  # --- Load peaks on-demand for this pool ---
  h5Path <- atacInputs.tmp[[poolName]]$arc_filtered_h5
  fragPath <- atacInputs.tmp[[poolName]]$arc_fragments

  cat(sprintf("  %s: Loading peaks from h5...\n", poolName))
  h5_data <- Read10X_h5(h5Path)
  peakMat <- h5_data[["Peaks"]]
  rm(h5_data)  # free GEX component from Arc h5 immediately

  # --- Barcode matching ---
  gexBarcodes <- colnames(seurat)
  arcBarcodes <- colnames(peakMat)

  # Try exact matching first
  exactMatches <- intersect(gexBarcodes, arcBarcodes)

  if (length(exactMatches) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d exact barcode matches (%.1f%% of GEX)\n",
      poolName, length(exactMatches), 100 * length(exactMatches) / length(gexBarcodes)))
    sharedGEXBarcodes <- exactMatches
    sharedArcBarcodes <- exactMatches

  } else {
    # Fallback: suffix-stripped matching with collision checks
    cat(sprintf("  %s: No exact matches, trying suffix-stripped matching...\n", poolName))
    gexBase <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", gexBarcodes)
    arcBase <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", arcBarcodes)

    if (sum(duplicated(gexBase)) > 0 || sum(duplicated(arcBase)) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  %s: Duplicates after suffix stripping — skipping (collision risk)\n", poolName))
      seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- FALSE
      seurat[["hasGEX"]] <- TRUE
      seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat
      rm(peakMat)
      gc(verbose = FALSE)
      next
    }

    sharedBase <- intersect(gexBase, arcBase)
    if (length(sharedBase) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  %s: No overlapping barcodes\n", poolName))
      seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- FALSE
      seurat[["hasGEX"]] <- TRUE
      seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat
      rm(peakMat)
      gc(verbose = FALSE)
      next
    }

    gexSharedIdx <- match(sharedBase, gexBase)
    arcSharedIdx <- match(sharedBase, arcBase)

    if (length(unique(gexSharedIdx)) != length(gexSharedIdx) ||
      length(unique(arcSharedIdx)) != length(arcSharedIdx)) {
      cat(sprintf("  %s: Mapping not one-to-one — skipping\n", poolName))
      seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- FALSE
      seurat[["hasGEX"]] <- TRUE
      seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat
      rm(peakMat)
      gc(verbose = FALSE)
      next
    }

    sharedGEXBarcodes <- gexBarcodes[gexSharedIdx]
    sharedArcBarcodes <- arcBarcodes[arcSharedIdx]
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d suffix-stripped matches\n", poolName, length(sharedBase)))
  }

  if (length(sharedGEXBarcodes) == 0) {
    seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- FALSE
    seurat[["hasGEX"]] <- TRUE
    seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat
    rm(peakMat)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    next
  }

  # --- Build ChromatinAssay for matched cells only ---
  peakMatSubset <- peakMat[, sharedArcBarcodes, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(peakMatSubset) <- sharedGEXBarcodes
  rm(peakMat)  # free full peak matrix
  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  # Convert fragment file (6-col → 5-col) if needed
  fragFilename <- paste0(poolName, "_atac_fragments.5col.tsv.gz")
  fragPath5col <- file.path(dataOutputDir, fragFilename)
  fragPath5col <- convertFragments6to5Column(fragPath, fragPath5col)

  # Create ChromatinAssay with fragments and annotations
  atacIntegrationSuccess <- FALSE
  tryCatch(
    {
      chromAssay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
        counts = peakMatSubset,
        sep = c(":", "-"),
        fragments = CreateFragmentObject(
          path = fragPath5col,
          cells = sharedGEXBarcodes
        ),
        annotation = annotations,
        genome = "hg38",
        min.cells = 0,
        min.features = 0
      )

      # Add ATAC assay directly — matched cells only, no zero-padding
      seurat[["ATAC"]] <- chromAssay
      atacIntegrationSuccess <- TRUE

      cat(sprintf("  %s: Added ATAC assay (%d peaks x %d cells, %.1f%% of GEX)\n",
        poolName, nrow(chromAssay), ncol(chromAssay),
        100 * ncol(chromAssay) / length(gexBarcodes)))
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("  %s: ATAC integration failed: %s", poolName, e$message))
    }
  )

  # Metadata flags
  seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- colnames(seurat) %in% sharedGEXBarcodes
  seurat[["hasGEX"]] <- TRUE
  Misc(seurat, "atacFragmentPath") <- fragPath5col

  if (!atacIntegrationSuccess) {
    seurat[["hasATAC"]] <- FALSE
  }

  seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seurat

  # Aggressive cleanup
  rm(peakMatSubset)
  if (exists("chromAssay")) rm(chromAssay)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# Summary
cat("\nATAC integration summary:\n")
for (poolName in names(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]]
  nTotal <- ncol(seurat)
  if ("hasATAC" %in% colnames(seurat@meta.data)) {
    nWithATAC <- sum(seurat$hasATAC, na.rm = TRUE)
    hasATACAssay <- "ATAC" %in% names(seurat@assays)
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d cells total, %d with ATAC (%.1f%%), ATAC assay: %s\n",
      poolName, nTotal, nWithATAC, 100 * nWithATAC / nTotal,
      ifelse(hasATACAssay, "YES", "NO")))
    if (hasATACAssay) {
      cat(sprintf("    ATAC dimensions: %d peaks x %d cells\n",
        nrow(seurat[["ATAC"]]), ncol(seurat[["ATAC"]])))
    }
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d cells total, no ATAC metadata\n", poolName, nTotal))
  }
}
```

```{r addQCMetricsAnno}
## Add QC metrics: percent mito, ribo, hemoglobin, complexity, and pool/project info
## Load Cell Ranger per_barcode_metrics.csv from Arc pipeline
##
## Cell Ranger Arc per_barcode_metrics.csv contains BOTH GEX and ATAC metrics
## because Arc is a multiome pipeline. Column names include both:
##   - GEX metrics: gex_umis_count, gex_genes_count, gex_conf_exonic_reads, etc.
##   - ATAC metrics: atac_fragments, atac_TSS_fragments, atac_peak_region_fragments, etc.
##
## Cell Ranger Multi does NOT produce per_barcode_metrics.csv in the per_sample_outs
## structure (only h5 matrices), so all metrics come from the Arc pipeline.

for (i in seq_along(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratObjects.tmp[[i]]
  poolName <- names(seuratObjects.tmp)[i]

  # Get subproject for this pool
  poolIdx <- which(P697_files_df$pool == poolName)
  subproject <- P697_files_df$subproject[poolIdx]

  # ----- Standard computed QC metrics -----

  # Percent mitochondrial genes (MT-)
  seurat[["percentMt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat, pattern = "^MT-")

  # Percent ribosomal genes (RPS and RPL)
  seurat[["percentRibo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat, pattern = "^RP[SL]")

  # Percent hemoglobin genes (HBA, HBB, etc. but not HBP)
  seurat[["percentHb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat, pattern = "^HB[^(P)]")

  # Library complexity: log10(genes) / log10(UMIs)
  # Higher values indicate more complex libraries; low values may indicate low quality
  seurat[["complexity"]] <- log10(seurat$nFeature_RNA) / log10(seurat$nCount_RNA)

  # Percent of counts from top 20 genes (high values may indicate ambient RNA or low diversity)
  countsMat <- GetAssayData(seurat, slot = "counts")
  top20Pct <- apply(countsMat, 2, function(x) {
    sum(sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(20, length(x))]) / sum(x) * 100
  })
  seurat[["pctCountsInTop20Genes"]] <- top20Pct

  # ----- Pool/project identifiers -----
  seurat[["pool"]] <- poolName
  seurat[["poolNum"]] <- i
  seurat[["subproject"]] <- subproject

  # ----- Load Cell Ranger metrics from Arc output (BOTH GEX and ATAC metrics) -----
  arcMetricsFile <- P697_files_df$arc_per_barcode_metrics[poolIdx]

  if (file.exists(arcMetricsFile)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Reading Arc per_barcode_metrics.csv for %s...\n", poolName))
    metricsDf <- read.csv(arcMetricsFile, row.names = 1)

    # Filter to cells in our Seurat object (match by barcode prefix)
    gexBarcodes <- colnames(seurat)
    gexBase <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", gexBarcodes)
    metricsBase <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", rownames(metricsDf))

    # Create mapping
    baseToGEX <- setNames(gexBarcodes, gexBase)
    baseToMetrics <- setNames(rownames(metricsDf), metricsBase)

    sharedBase <- intersect(gexBase, metricsBase)

    if (length(sharedBase) > 0) {
      # Subset metrics to shared cells
      metricsSubset <- metricsDf[baseToMetrics[sharedBase], , drop = FALSE]
      rownames(metricsSubset) <- baseToGEX[sharedBase]

      # Add metrics with prefixes to distinguish GEX vs ATAC modality
      # cr_arc_gex_* = GEX metrics from Arc pipeline
      # cr_arc_atac_* = ATAC metrics from Arc pipeline
      for (col in colnames(metricsSubset)) {
        if (!all(is.na(metricsSubset[[col]]))) {
          # Determine if this is a GEX or ATAC metric based on column name
          if (grepl("^gex_", col)) {
            colName <- paste0("cr_arc_gex_", sub("^gex_", "", col))
          } else if (grepl("^atac_", col)) {
            colName <- paste0("cr_arc_atac_", sub("^atac_", "", col))
          } else {
            # Non-modality-specific columns (barcode, is_cell, excluded_reason)
            colName <- paste0("cr_arc_", col)
          }

          # Create a vector for all cells, fill with NA, then assign matching values
          metricVec <- rep(NA, ncol(seurat))
          names(metricVec) <- colnames(seurat)
          metricVec[rownames(metricsSubset)] <- metricsSubset[[col]]
          seurat[[colName]] <- metricVec
        }
      }
      cat(sprintf("    Added %d Arc metrics (GEX + ATAC) for %d cells\n",
        ncol(metricsSubset), length(sharedBase)))
    }
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("Arc per_barcode_metrics.csv not found for %s", poolName))
  }

  seuratObjects.tmp[[i]] <- seurat
}

# Print summary of QC metrics added
cat("\nQC metrics summary for first pool:\n")
qcCols <- grep("percent|complexity|pct|cr_", colnames(seuratObjects.tmp[[1]]@meta.data), value = TRUE)
cat("  Computed metrics:", paste(qcCols[!grepl("^cr_", qcCols)], collapse = ", "), "\n")
crCols <- qcCols[grepl("^cr_", qcCols)]
if (length(crCols) > 0) {
  # Separate by modality
  gexCols <- crCols[grepl("^cr_arc_gex_", crCols)]
  atacCols <- crCols[grepl("^cr_arc_atac_", crCols)]
  otherCols <- crCols[!grepl("^cr_arc_(gex|atac)_", crCols)]

  cat("\n  Cell Ranger Arc metrics loaded:\n")
  if (length(gexCols) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("    GEX metrics (%d): %s\n", length(gexCols),
      paste(head(sub("^cr_arc_gex_", "", gexCols), 10), collapse = ", ")))
    if (length(gexCols) > 10) cat(sprintf("      ... and %d more\n", length(gexCols) - 10))
  }
  if (length(atacCols) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("    ATAC metrics (%d): %s\n", length(atacCols),
      paste(head(sub("^cr_arc_atac_", "", atacCols), 10), collapse = ", ")))
    if (length(atacCols) > 10) cat(sprintf("      ... and %d more\n", length(atacCols) - 10))
  }
  if (length(otherCols) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("    Other metrics (%d): %s\n", length(otherCols),
      paste(head(sub("^cr_arc_", "", otherCols), 5), collapse = ", ")))
  }
} else {
  cat("  No Cell Ranger metrics found - check file paths!\n")
}

# Check which Arc metrics files were found
cat("\nArc per_barcode_metrics files:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(P697_files_df))) {
  f <- P697_files_df$arc_per_barcode_metrics[i]
  exists <- file.exists(f)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %s %s\n",   # <-- change from 4 spaces to 2
    P697_files_df$pool[i],
    ifelse(exists, "✓", "✗"),
    ifelse(exists, "", paste0("(not found: ", basename(f), ")"))))
}

# Summary by subproject
cat("\nCells per subproject:\n")
for (sp in unique(P697_files_df$subproject)) {
  poolsInSP <- P697_files_df$pool[P697_files_df$subproject == sp]
  nCells <- sum(sapply(poolsInSP, function(p) {
    if (p %in% names(seuratObjects.tmp)) ncol(seuratObjects.tmp[[p]]) else 0
  }))
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d cells\n", sp, nCells))
}
```

```{r plotNFeatures, fig.height = 6, fig.width=12}
# Select QC cutoffs

nrow <- 2  # 2 subprojects

)
```

```{r plotQCCorrelations, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8}
# Multi-metric QC scatter plots to examine correlations between QC metrics
qcScatterPlots <- lapply(names(seuratObjects.tmp), function(nm) {
  x <- seuratObjects.tmp[[nm]]
  df <- data.frame(
    nCount_RNA = x$nCount_RNA,
    nFeature_RNA = x$nFeature_RNA,
    percentMt = x$percentMt,
    percentRibo = x$percentRibo,
    complexity = x$complexity
  )

  # UMI vs genes colored by mito %
  p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = nFeature_RNA, color = percentMt)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", limits = c(0, 20)) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(x = "UMI counts", y = "Genes detected", color = "% mito") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  # Mito vs Ribo
  p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = percentMt, y = percentRibo)) +
    geom_pointdensity(size = 0.3) +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = pctMt, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = pctRibo, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(x = "% mitochondrial", y = "% ribosomal") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  # Complexity vs UMI counts
  p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = complexity, color = percentMt)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", limits = c(0, 20)) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(x = "UMI counts", y = "Complexity", color = "% mito") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  combined <- (p1 | p2 | p3) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = nm)

  return(combined)
})

# Save each pool's correlation plot
for (i in seq_along(qcScatterPlots)) {
  nm <- names(seuratObjects.tmp)[i]
  savePlot(
    plot = qcScatterPlots[[i]],
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0("QCcorrelations_", nm),
    height = 4,
    width = 12,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )
}
```

```{r plotQCViolinCombined, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 10}
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

pTop20 <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = pctCountsInTop20Genes, fill = pool)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "", y = "% in top 20 genes") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

qcViolinsCombined <- (pNCount | pNFeature | pMito) / (pRibo | pComplexity | pTop20) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "QC metrics across pools")

savePlot(
  plot = qcViolinsCombined,
  plotDir = plotDir,
  filename = "QCviolins_allPools",
  height = 8,
  width = 12,
  formats = c("pdf", "png")
)
```

```{r plotCellRangerGEXMetrics, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10}
# Visualize key Cell Ranger GEX metrics from Arc pipeline
# Note: Arc per_barcode_metrics.csv contains both GEX and ATAC metrics
# Check if CR metrics exist in the first pool
hasCRMetrics <- any(grepl("^cr_arc_", colnames(seuratObjects.tmp[[1]]@meta.data)))

if (hasCRMetrics) {
  cat("Plotting Cell Ranger GEX metrics (from Arc pipeline)...\n")

  # Store plots for combined display
  gexPlotList <- list()

  # Exonic vs Intronic ratio - useful for distinguishing nuclei from whole cells
  # Nuclei tend to have higher intronic reads due to unspliced transcripts
  if (all(c("cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_reads", "cr_arc_gex_conf_intronic_reads") %in%
    colnames(combinedMeta))) {

    combinedMeta$exonicIntronicRatio <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_reads /
      (combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_intronic_reads + 1)  # +1 to avoid div by zero

    combinedMeta$pctIntronic <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_intronic_reads /
      (combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_reads + combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_intronic_reads) * 100

    pIntronic <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = pctIntronic, fill = pool)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
      labs(x = "", y = "% intronic reads",
        title = "Intronic read fraction (higher = more nuclear RNA)") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    gexPlotList[["intronic"]] <- pIntronic
  }

  # Mapped reads distribution
  if ("cr_arc_gex_mapped_reads" %in% colnames(combinedMeta)) {
    pMapped <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = cr_arc_gex_mapped_reads, fill = pool)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(x = "", y = "Mapped reads (log10)", title = "GEX mapped reads per cell") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    gexPlotList[["mapped"]] <- pMapped
  }

  # Duplication rate - high duplication can indicate over-sequencing or low complexity
  if (all(c("cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_dup_reads", "cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_unique_reads") %in%
    colnames(combinedMeta))) {

    combinedMeta$gexDupRate <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_dup_reads /
      (combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_dup_reads + combinedMeta$cr_arc_gex_conf_exonic_unique_reads) * 100

    pDup <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = gexDupRate, fill = pool)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
      labs(x = "", y = "GEX duplication rate (%)", title = "Exonic read duplication rate") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    gexPlotList[["duplication"]] <- pDup
  }

  # Display combined plots
  if (length(gexPlotList) > 0) {
    if (length(gexPlotList) == 1) {
      combinedPlot <- gexPlotList[[1]]
    } else if (length(gexPlotList) == 2) {
      combinedPlot <- gexPlotList[[1]] | gexPlotList[[2]]
    } else {
      combinedPlot <- (gexPlotList[[1]] | gexPlotList[[2]]) / gexPlotList[[3]]
    }

    print(combinedPlot)

    # Save combined plot
    savePlot(
      plot = combinedPlot,
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = "CR_GEXmetrics_combined",
      height = 8,
      width = 12,
      formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
  }
} else {
  cat("No Cell Ranger metrics found - skipping CR GEX plots\n")
}
```

```{r plotCellRangerATACMetrics, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 12}
# Visualize key Cell Ranger ATAC metrics - critical for TEAseq QC
# Note: These metrics come from Arc per_barcode_metrics.csv
if (hasCRMetrics && "cr_arc_atac_fragments" %in% colnames(combinedMeta)) {
  cat("Plotting Cell Ranger ATAC metrics (from Arc pipeline)...\n")

  # ATAC fragments per cell - key metric for ATAC quality
  pATACFrags <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = cr_arc_atac_fragments, fill = pool)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "", y = "ATAC fragments (log10)", title = "ATAC fragments per cell") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # TSS enrichment score - fragments at TSS / expected
  # Higher is better; typically want > 4-5
  if ("cr_arc_atac_TSS_fragments" %in% colnames(combinedMeta)) {
    combinedMeta$tssEnrichment <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_TSS_fragments /
      (combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_fragments + 1) * 100

    pTSS <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = tssEnrichment, fill = pool)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
      labs(x = "", y = "% fragments at TSS", title = "TSS enrichment") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }

  # Fraction of reads in peaks (FRiP) - key ATAC quality metric
  # Higher is better; typically want > 20-30%
  if ("cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments" %in% colnames(combinedMeta)) {
    combinedMeta$frip <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments /
      (combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_fragments + 1) * 100
    (combinedMeta$cr_atac_fragments + 1) * 100

    pFRiP <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = frip, fill = pool)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      labs(x = "", y = "% fragments in peaks (FRiP)",
        title = "Fraction of reads in peaks") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }

  # ATAC mitochondrial reads - should be low for good quality
  if ("cr_arc_atac_mitochondrial_reads" %in% colnames(combinedMeta)) {
    combinedMeta$atacMitoPct <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_mitochondrial_reads /
      (combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_fragments + 1) * 100
    (combinedMeta$cr_atac_raw_reads + 1) * 100

    pATACMito <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = pool, y = atacMitoPct, fill = pool)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
      labs(x = "", y = "% ATAC mitochondrial reads",
        title = "ATAC mitochondrial contamination") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }

  # Combine ATAC QC plots
  atacPlotsAvailable <- c(
    exists("pATACFrags"), exists("pTSS"), exists("pFRiP"), exists("pATACMito")
  )

  if (sum(atacPlotsAvailable) >= 4) {
    atacCombined <- (pATACFrags | pTSS) / (pFRiP | pATACMito) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "ATAC QC metrics across pools")
  } else if (sum(atacPlotsAvailable) >= 2) {
    atacCombined <- pATACFrags | pFRiP +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "ATAC QC metrics across pools")
  } else {
    atacCombined <- pATACFrags
  }

  savePlot(
    plot = atacCombined,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = "CR_ATACmetrics_combined",
    height = 8,
    width = 12,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )
} else {
  cat("No ATAC metrics found - skipping CR ATAC plots\n")
}
```

```{r atacNucleosomeSignal, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 12, message = FALSE}
# Compute nucleosome signal per cell from fragment files
# This is the main Signac-style metric we don't already have from Cell Ranger
#
# Nucleosome signal = mononucleosomal fragments (147-294bp) / nucleosome-free fragments (<147bp)
# Lower values indicate more open/accessible chromatin (good for ATAC)
# Signac recommends filtering cells with NS > 4

# Function to read fragment file and compute nucleosome signal
computeNucleosomeSignalFromFrags <- function(fragFile, validBarcodes, nSample = 5000000) {
  cat(sprintf("  Reading fragment file...\n"))

  # Read fragments using data.table (handles 6-column Cell Ranger ARC format)
  cmd <- sprintf("gunzip -c '%s' | grep -v '^#' | head -n %d", fragFile, nSample)
  frags <- data.table::fread(cmd = cmd, header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
    col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "barcode", "count", "strand"))

  # Calculate fragment length
  frags$length <- frags$end - frags$start

  # Filter to valid barcodes
  frags <- frags[frags$barcode %in% validBarcodes, ]
  cat(sprintf("  %d fragments from %d valid cells\n", nrow(frags), length(unique(frags$barcode))))

  # Expand by count and classify by fragment length
  cat("  Computing nucleosome signal...\n")
  fragsExpanded <- frags[rep(seq_len(nrow(frags)), frags$count), ]
  fragsExpanded$region <- ifelse(fragsExpanded$length < 147, "nucleosomeFree",
    ifelse(fragsExpanded$length <= 294, "mononucleosomal", "other"))

  # Count per barcode
  nsDF <- fragsExpanded %>%
    group_by(barcode, region) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      nucleosomeSignal = mononucleosomal / (nucleosomeFree + 1)
    )

  return(list(nsDF = nsDF, frags = frags))
}

# Process each pool
nsResults <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(P697_files_df))) {
  poolName <- P697_files_df$pool[i]
  fragmentsFile <- P697_files_df$arc_fragments[i]

  if (!file.exists(fragmentsFile)) {
    cat(sprintf("Fragments file not found for %s, skipping\n", poolName))
    next
  }

  cat(sprintf("\nProcessing nucleosome signal for %s...\n", poolName))

  tryCatch(
    {
      validBarcodes <- colnames(seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]])
      result <- computeNucleosomeSignalFromFrags(fragmentsFile, validBarcodes)
      result$nsDF$pool <- poolName
      nsResults[[poolName]] <- result
      cat(sprintf("  Computed for %d cells\n", nrow(result$nsDF)))
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("  Error: %s\n", e$message))
    })
}

# Create plots if we have results
if (length(nsResults) > 0) {
  # Combine nucleosome signal data
  combinedNSDF <- do.call(rbind, lapply(nsResults, function(x) x$nsDF))
  combinedNSDF$nucleosomeGroup <- ifelse(combinedNSDF$nucleosomeSignal > 4, "NS > 4", "NS ≤ 4")

  # 1. Fragment length histograms grouped by nucleosome signal (per pool)
  for (poolName in names(nsResults)) {
    frags <- nsResults[[poolName]]$frags
    nsDF <- nsResults[[poolName]]$nsDF
    nsDF$nucleosomeGroup <- ifelse(nsDF$nucleosomeSignal > 4, "NS > 4", "NS ≤ 4")

    # Merge nucleosome group into fragments
    fragsPlot <- merge(frags, nsDF[, c("barcode", "nucleosomeGroup")], by = "barcode")

    # Sample for plotting
    if (nrow(fragsPlot) > 500000) {
      set.seed(42)
      fragsPlot <- fragsPlot[sample(nrow(fragsPlot), 500000), ]
    }

    pFragNS <- ggplot(fragsPlot, aes(x = length, fill = nucleosomeGroup)) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 200, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(147, 294), linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey") +
      annotate("text", x = c(73, 220), y = Inf, label = c("NFR", "Mono"),
        vjust = 2, size = 3, color = "darkgrey") +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 800)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("NS ≤ 4" = "steelblue", "NS > 4" = "coral")) +
      labs(title = paste0("Fragment Length by Nucleosome Signal: ", poolName),
        subtitle = "Cells with NS > 4 (coral) have more mononucleosomal fragments",
        x = "Fragment Length (bp)", y = "Density", fill = "") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "top")

    savePlot(
      plot = pFragNS,
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = paste0("ATAC_FragmentByNS_", poolName),
      height = 5,
      width = 8,
      formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
  }

  # 2. Nucleosome signal violin plots across pools
  pNSViolin <- ggplot(combinedNSDF, aes(x = pool, y = nucleosomeSignal, fill = pool)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 4, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Nucleosome Signal (log10)",
      title = "Nucleosome Signal",
      subtitle = "Ratio of mononucleosomal to nucleosome-free fragments (lower is better)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # 3. NFR and mononucleosomal fragment counts
  pNFR <- ggplot(combinedNSDF, aes(x = pool, y = nucleosomeFree, fill = pool)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "", y = "NFR Fragments (log10)", title = "Nucleosome-Free Fragments \n(<147bp)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  pMono <- ggplot(combinedNSDF, aes(x = pool, y = mononucleosomal, fill = pool)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.size = 0.5) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Mono Fragments (log10)", title = "Mononucleosomal Fragments \n(147-294bp)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # 4. Combined panel
  nsCombined <- (pNSViolin | pNFR | pMono) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "ATAC Nucleosome Signal QC",
      subtitle = "Red dashed line at NS = 4 (cells above may have poor chromatin accessibility)"
    )

  savePlot(
    plot = nsCombined,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = "ATAC_NucleosomeSignal_allPools",
    height = 5,
    width = 12,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # 5. Scatter: nucleosome signal vs ATAC fragments (from Cell Ranger if available)
  # Add nucleosome signal to Seurat objects for downstream use
  for (poolName in names(nsResults)) {
    nsDF <- nsResults[[poolName]]$nsDF
    seuratObj <- seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]]

    # Match barcodes
    nsVals <- nsDF$nucleosomeSignal[match(colnames(seuratObj), nsDF$barcode)]
    seuratObj[["nucleosomeSignal"]] <- nsVals

    nfrVals <- nsDF$nucleosomeFree[match(colnames(seuratObj), nsDF$barcode)]
    seuratObj[["nfrFragments"]] <- nfrVals

    monoVals <- nsDF$mononucleosomal[match(colnames(seuratObj), nsDF$barcode)]
    seuratObj[["monoFragments"]] <- monoVals

    seuratObjects.tmp[[poolName]] <- seuratObj
  }

  # Print summary
  cat("\n=== Nucleosome Signal Summary ===\n")
  nsSummary <- combinedNSDF %>%
    group_by(pool) %>%
    summarise(
      nCells = n(),
      median_NS = round(median(nucleosomeSignal, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      median_NFR = round(median(nucleosomeFree, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      medianMono = round(median(mononucleosomal, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      pctPassNS = round(mean(nucleosomeSignal < 4, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(as.data.frame(nsSummary), row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\n  Suggested threshold: nucleosomeSignal < 4\n")
  cat("  Lower values indicate more accessible chromatin (better ATAC quality)\n")

} else {
  cat("No nucleosome signal results - check that fragment files exist\n")
}
```

```{r atacTSSEnrichmentProfile, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10, message = FALSE}
# TSS Enrichment Profiles and Density Scatter plots
# These are key Signac-style ATAC QC visualizations

# Load gene annotations from Cell Ranger reference GTF for TSS positions
cellRangerArcRef <- "/Volumes/bioinformatics/pipeline/annotation/pipeline/10x/refdata-cellranger-arc-GRCh38-2024-A"
gtfFile <- file.path(cellRangerArcRef, "genes", "genes.gtf.gz")

if (file.exists(gtfFile)) {
  cat("Loading gene annotations for TSS positions...\n")
  annotations <- rtracklayer::import(gtfFile)
  annotations <- annotations[annotations$type == "gene"]

  # Get TSS positions (start for + strand, end for - strand)
  tssPos <- ifelse(strand(annotations) == "+", start(annotations), end(annotations))
  tssGR <- GRanges(
    seqnames = seqnames(annotations),
    ranges = IRanges(start = tssPos, width = 1),
    strand = strand(annotations)
  )
  cat(sprintf("  Loaded %d gene TSS positions\n", length(tssGR)))

  # Compute TSS enrichment profiles from fragment files
  tssProfiles <- list()
  flankSize <- 2000  # bp on each side of TSS

  for (poolName in names(nsResults)) {
    cat(sprintf("\nComputing TSS enrichment profile for %s...\n", poolName))

    tryCatch(
      {
        frags <- nsResults[[poolName]]$frags

        # Convert fragments to GRanges (use fragment midpoints)
        fragsGR <- GRanges(
          seqnames = frags$chr,
          ranges = IRanges(start = (frags$start + frags$end) / 2, width = 1),
          count = frags$count
        )

        # Find overlaps with TSS flanking regions
        tssFlanks <- promoters(tssGR, upstream = flankSize, downstream = flankSize)
        overlaps <- findOverlaps(fragsGR, tssFlanks)

        if (length(overlaps) > 0) {
          # Get distances from TSS
          fragHits <- fragsGR[queryHits(overlaps)]
          tssHits <- tssGR[subjectHits(overlaps)]

          distances <- start(fragHits) - start(tssHits)
          # Adjust for strand (flip for minus strand genes)
          distances <- ifelse(strand(tssHits) == "-", -distances, distances)

          # Create profile data
          profileDF <- data.frame(
            distance = distances,
            count = fragHits$count
          )

          # Bin and aggregate
          profileDF$bin <- cut(profileDF$distance,
            breaks = seq(-flankSize, flankSize, by = 25),
            labels = seq(-flankSize + 12.5, flankSize - 12.5, by = 25),
            include.lowest = TRUE)

          aggProfile <- profileDF %>%
            group_by(bin) %>%
            summarise(signal = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
            mutate(
              position = as.numeric(as.character(bin)),
              pool = poolName
            )

          tssProfiles[[poolName]] <- aggProfile
          cat(sprintf("  Computed profile from %d overlapping fragments\n", length(overlaps)))
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("  Error: %s\n", e$message))
      })
  }

  # Plot TSS enrichment profiles
  if (length(tssProfiles) > 0) {
    combinedTSSProfiles <- do.call(rbind, tssProfiles)

    # Normalize each pool's profile to flanking regions
    combinedTSSProfiles <- combinedTSSProfiles %>%
      group_by(pool) %>%
      mutate(
        flankMean = mean(signal[abs(position) > 1500], na.rm = TRUE),
        normalizedSignal = signal / flankMean
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

    # Per-pool TSS profiles
    for (poolName in names(tssProfiles)) {
      poolProfile <- combinedTSSProfiles %>% filter(pool == poolName)

      pTSS <- ggplot(poolProfile, aes(x = position, y = normalizedSignal)) +
        geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
        labs(
          title = paste0("TSS Enrichment Profile: ", poolName),
          subtitle = "Fragment signal normalized to flanking regions",
          x = "Distance from TSS (bp)",
          y = "Normalized Signal"
        ) +
        theme_bw()

      savePlot(
        plot = pTSS,
        plotDir = plotDir,
        filename = paste0("ATAC_TSSProfile_", poolName),
        height = 5,
        width = 8,
        formats = c("pdf", "png")
      )
    }

    # Combined overlay plot
    pTSSOverlay <- ggplot(combinedTSSProfiles, aes(x = position, y = normalizedSignal, color = pool)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
      labs(
        title = "TSS Enrichment Profiles (All Pools)",
        subtitle = "Fragment signal normalized to flanking regions; peak at TSS indicates good ATAC quality",
        x = "Distance from TSS (bp)",
        y = "Normalized Signal",
        color = "Pool"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "right")

    savePlot(
      plot = pTSSOverlay,
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = "ATAC_TSSProfile_allPools",
      height = 5,
      width = 10,
      formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )

    cat("\nTSS enrichment profiles saved\n")
  }

} else {
  cat("GTF file not found - skipping TSS enrichment profiles\n")
}
```

```{r atacDensityScatter, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10, message = FALSE}
# Signac-style density scatter: TSS enrichment vs nCount_peaks
# Uses Cell Ranger metrics already loaded in the Seurat objects

# ATAC QC thresholds for density scatter plots
peakFragmentsMin <- 1500   # Minimum fragments in peaks per cell
tssEnrichmentMin <- 2      # Minimum TSS enrichment percentage

# Combine metadata from all pools (need to recreate combinedMeta here)
combinedMetaATAC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(seuratObjects.tmp), function(nm) {
  x <- seuratObjects.tmp[[nm]]
  df <- x@meta.data
  df$pool <- nm
  df$barcode <- rownames(df)
  df
}))

# Check if we have the required Cell Ranger ATAC metrics
hasATACMetrics <- all(c("cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments", "cr_arc_atac_TSS_fragments") %in%
  colnames(combinedMetaATAC))

if (hasATACMetrics) {
  cat("Creating density scatter plots using Cell Ranger ATAC metrics...\n")

  # Calculate TSS enrichment as % of fragments at TSS
  combinedMetaATAC$tssEnrichmentPct <- combinedMetaATAC$cr_arc_atac_TSS_fragments /
    (combinedMetaATAC$cr_arc_atac_fragments + 1) * 100

  # Per-pool density scatter plots
  for (poolName in unique(combinedMetaATAC$pool)) {
    poolData <- combinedMetaATAC %>% filter(pool == poolName)

    # Filter out zeros/NAs for log scale
    poolData <- poolData %>%
      filter(cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments > 0, tssEnrichmentPct > 0)

    pDensity <- ggplot(poolData, aes(x = cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments, y = tssEnrichmentPct)) +
      geom_pointdensity(size = 0.5) +
      scale_color_viridis_c() +
      scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = peakFragmentsMin, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = tssEnrichmentMin, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("ATAC QC Density Scatter: ", poolName),
        subtitle = sprintf("Red lines: QC thresholds (peaks > %d, TSS > %d%%)", peakFragmentsMin, tssEnrichmentMin),
        x = "Fragments in Peaks (log10)",
        y = "TSS Enrichment (%)"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")

    savePlot(
      plot = pDensity,
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = paste0("ATAC_DensityScatter_", poolName),
      height = 5,
      width = 6,
      formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
  }

  # Combined faceted density scatter
  combinedMetaATACFiltered <- combinedMetaATAC %>%
    filter(cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments > 0, tssEnrichmentPct > 0)

  pDensityAll <- ggplot(combinedMetaATACFiltered,
    aes(x = cr_arc_atac_peak_region_fragments, y = tssEnrichmentPct)) +
    geom_pointdensity(size = 0.3) +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = peakFragmentsMin, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = tssEnrichmentMin, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~pool, ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "ATAC QC Density Scatter (All Pools)",
      subtitle = sprintf("Red lines: QC thresholds (peaks > %d, TSS > %d%%)", peakFragmentsMin, tssEnrichmentMin),
      x = "Fragments in Peaks (log10)",
      y = "TSS Enrichment (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  savePlot(
    plot = pDensityAll,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = "ATAC_DensityScatter_allPools",
    height = 8,
    width = 10,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # Also create nucleosome signal vs TSS enrichment scatter if we have both
  if ("nucleosomeSignal" %in% colnames(combinedMetaATAC)) {
    combinedMetaATACNS <- combinedMetaATAC %>%
      filter(!is.na(nucleosomeSignal), nucleosomeSignal > 0, tssEnrichmentPct > 0)

    pNSTSS <- ggplot(combinedMetaATACNS, aes(x = nucleosomeSignal, y = tssEnrichmentPct)) +
      geom_pointdensity(size = 0.3) +
      scale_color_viridis_c() +
      scale_x_log10() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 4, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~pool, ncol = 2) +
      labs(
        title = "Nucleosome Signal vs TSS Enrichment",
        subtitle = "Good cells: low NS (<4), high TSS (>2%)",
        x = "Nucleosome Signal (log10)",
        y = "TSS Enrichment (%)"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")

    savePlot(
      plot = pNSTSS,
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = "ATAC_NS_vs_TSS_allPools",
      height = 8,
      width = 10,
      formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
  }

  cat("\nDensity scatter plots saved\n")

} else {
  cat("Cell Ranger ATAC metrics not found - skipping density scatter plots\n")
  cat("  Required: cr_atac_peak_region_fragments, cr_atac_TSS_fragments\n")
}
```

```{r plotGEXATACCorrelation, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10}
# Joint GEX-ATAC QC scatter plots - important for TEAseq to ensure both modalities are good
# Define ATAC-specific QC thresholds (use same as atacDensityScatter where applicable)
atacFragmentsMin <- 1000   # Minimum total ATAC fragments per cell
# peakFragmentsMin defined in atacDensityScatter chunk
# tssEnrichmentMin defined in atacDensityScatter chunk
fripMin <- 20              # Minimum fraction of reads in peaks (%)

if (hasCRMetrics && all(c("cr_arc_atac_fragments", "cr_arc_gex_umis_count") %in% colnames(combinedMeta))) {
  cat("Plotting GEX-ATAC correlation metrics...\n")

  # GEX UMIs vs ATAC fragments - should be correlated for good multiome cells
  pGEXATAC <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = cr_arc_gex_umis_count, y = cr_arc_atac_fragments, color = pool)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = atacFragmentsMin, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "GEX UMI counts (log10)", y = "ATAC fragments (log10)",
      title = "GEX vs ATAC quality correlation") +
    theme_bw() +
    facet_wrap(~pool, ncol = 2)

  savePlot(
    plot = pGEXATAC,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = "GEX_ATAC_correlation",
    height = 6,
    width = 10,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # Combined quality: cells should have both good GEX and ATAC

  # GEX pass criteria: nFeature within range, low mito, low ribo
  combinedMeta$gexPass <- combinedMeta$nFeature_RNA > nFeatureLow &
    combinedMeta$nFeature_RNA < nFeatureHigh &
    combinedMeta$percentMt < pctMt &
    combinedMeta$percentRibo < pctRibo

  # ATAC pass criteria: sufficient fragments and FRiP (if available)
  if ("frip" %in% colnames(combinedMeta)) {
    combinedMeta$atacPass <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_fragments > atacFragmentsMin &
      combinedMeta$frip > fripMin
  } else {
    combinedMeta$atacPass <- combinedMeta$cr_arc_atac_fragments > atacFragmentsMin
  }

  combinedMeta$jointQC <- case_when(
    combinedMeta$gexPass & combinedMeta$atacPass ~ "Both pass",
    combinedMeta$gexPass & !combinedMeta$atacPass ~ "GEX only",
    !combinedMeta$gexPass & combinedMeta$atacPass ~ "ATAC only",
    TRUE ~ "Neither"
  )

  pJointQC <- ggplot(combinedMeta, aes(x = cr_arc_gex_umis_count, y = cr_arc_atac_fragments,
    color = jointQC)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Both pass" = "darkgreen", "GEX only" = "blue",
      "ATAC only" = "orange", "Neither" = "grey70")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = atacFragmentsMin, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "GEX UMI counts (log10)", y = "ATAC fragments (log10)",
      color = "QC status", title = "Joint GEX-ATAC quality classification") +
    theme_bw() +
    facet_wrap(~pool, ncol = 2)

  savePlot(
    plot = pJointQC,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = "GEX_ATAC_jointQC",
    height = 6,
    width = 10,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # Summary table of joint QC
  jointQCSummary <- combinedMeta %>%
    group_by(pool, jointQC) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(pool) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    ungroup()

  cat("\nJoint GEX-ATAC QC summary:\n")
  cat(sprintf("GEX criteria: %d < nFeature < %d, percentMt < %d%%, percentRibo < %d%%\n",
    nFeatureLow, nFeatureHigh, pctMt, pctRibo))
  cat(sprintf("ATAC criteria: fragments > %d, FRiP > %d%%\n", atacFragmentsMin, fripMin))
  print(as.data.frame(jointQCSummary), row.names = FALSE)

  # Save joint QC summary to CSV
  write.csv(jointQCSummary,
    file = file.path(dataOutputDir, "jointQCSummary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\nJoint QC summary saved to: %s\n", file.path(dataOutputDir, "jointQCSummary.csv")))

  # Save condensed summary (all pools combined)
  jointQCSummaryCombined <- combinedMeta %>%
    group_by(jointQC) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

  write.csv(jointQCSummaryCombined,
    file = file.path(dataOutputDir, "jointQCSummaryCombined.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("Combined QC summary saved to: %s\n", file.path(dataOutputDir, "jointQCSummaryCombined.csv")))

  cat("\nCombined Joint QC summary (all pools):\n")
  print(as.data.frame(jointQCSummaryCombined), row.names = FALSE)

} else {
  cat("GEX-ATAC correlation plot requires both cr_atac_fragments and cr_gex_umis_count\n")
}
```

```{r addAnno}
## Load annotation files for both subprojects
## Both P697-1 and P697-2 now use LabDB format (single sheet)

cat("Loading annotation files...\n")

# Function to clean column names to camelCase format
cleanColumnNames <- function(colNames) {
  colNames <- gsub("\\s+", " ", colNames)  # Normalize whitespace
  colNames <- gsub("#", "Num", colNames)  # Hash/pound to Num
  colNames <- gsub("%", "Percent", colNames)  # Percent sign
  colNames <- gsub("/", "Per", colNames)  # Forward slash to Per
  colNames <- gsub("[()\\._-]", " ", colNames)  # Remove parens, periods, underscores, dashes
  colNames <- gsub("\\\\", "", colNames)  # Remove backslashes
  colNames <- gsub("\\s+", " ", colNames)  # Clean up extra spaces again
  colNames <- trimws(colNames)  # Trim leading/trailing spaces

  # Convert to camelCase while preserving all-caps acronyms
  result <- sapply(colNames, function(name) {
    words <- strsplit(name, "\\s+")[[1]]
    # Keep all-caps words (DNA, ID, etc.) as-is, capitalize first letter of others
    words <- sapply(seq_along(words), function(i) {
      word <- words[i]
      # If word is all caps and length > 1, keep it (DNA, ID, PCR, etc.)
      if (nchar(word) > 1 && word == toupper(word)) {
        return(word)
      }
      # First word: lowercase first letter unless it's an acronym
      if (i == 1) {
        return(paste0(tolower(substr(word, 1, 1)), substr(word, 2, nchar(word))))
      }
      # Subsequent words: capitalize first letter
      return(paste0(toupper(substr(word, 1, 1)), substr(word, 2, nchar(word))))
    })
    paste(words, collapse = "")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  # Fix common acronym patterns that got mangled (dNA -> DNA, cDNA -> cDNA, rNA -> RNA)
  result <- gsub("^dNA", "DNA", result)  # dNASampleId -> DNASampleId
  result <- gsub("^cDNA", "cDNA", result)  # Keep cDNA as is (common notation)
  result <- gsub("^rNA", "RNA", result)  # rNASampleId -> RNASampleId

  return(result)
}

# ----- P697-1: LabDB format -----
annoP697_1_file <- file.path(dataInputDir,
  "LabDB _ P697-1_ TEAseq studies on samples from a low dose IL-2 trial in T1D.xlsx")

if (file.exists(annoP697_1_file)) {
  annoP697_1 <- read_excel(annoP697_1_file)
  colnames(annoP697_1) <- cleanColumnNames(colnames(annoP697_1))
  annoP697_1$subproject <- "P697-1"
  cat(sprintf("  P697-1: Loaded %d rows from LabDB file\n", nrow(annoP697_1)))
  cat(sprintf("    Cleaned columns: %s\n", paste(colnames(annoP697_1)[1:min(10, ncol(annoP697_1))], collapse = ", ")))
} else {
  warning("P697-1 annotation file not found!")
  annoP697_1 <- NULL
}

# ----- P697-2: LabDB format -----
annoP697_2_file <- file.path(dataInputDir,
  "LabDB _ P697-2_ TEAseq studies on samples from a low dose IL-2 trial in T1D.xlsx")

if (file.exists(annoP697_2_file)) {
  annoP697_2 <- read_excel(annoP697_2_file)
  colnames(annoP697_2) <- cleanColumnNames(colnames(annoP697_2))
  annoP697_2$subproject <- "P697-2"
  cat(sprintf("  P697-2: Loaded %d rows from LabDB file\n", nrow(annoP697_2)))
  cat(sprintf("    Cleaned columns: %s\n", paste(colnames(annoP697_2)[1:min(10, ncol(annoP697_2))], collapse = ", ")))
} else {
  warning("P697-2 annotation file not found!")
  annoP697_2 <- NULL
}

# ----- Combine annotations -----
# Select common columns that exist in both
if (!is.null(annoP697_1) && !is.null(annoP697_2)) {
  # Identify common columns (after harmonization)
  commonCols <- intersect(colnames(annoP697_1), colnames(annoP697_2))
  cat(sprintf("\n  Common columns (%d): %s\n", length(commonCols),
    paste(head(commonCols, 15), collapse = ", ")))
  if (length(commonCols) > 15) cat(sprintf("    ... and %d more\n", length(commonCols) - 15))

  # Combine using all common columns
  annoP697 <- bind_rows(
    annoP697_1 %>% select(all_of(commonCols)),
    annoP697_2 %>% select(all_of(commonCols))
  )

  # set visit as a character
  annoP697$visitNum <- as.character(annoP697$visitNum)

  cat(sprintf("\nCombined annotation: %d rows, %d columns\n", nrow(annoP697), ncol(annoP697)))
  if ("donorID" %in% colnames(annoP697) && "subproject" %in% colnames(annoP697)) {
    cat("Donors per subproject:\n")
    print(table(annoP697$subproject, annoP697$donorID))
  }
} else if (!is.null(annoP697_1)) {
  annoP697 <- annoP697_1
  cat("\nUsing P697-1 annotation only\n")
} else if (!is.null(annoP697_2)) {
  annoP697 <- annoP697_2
  cat("\nUsing P697-2 annotation only\n")
} else {
  stop("No annotation files found!")
}
```

```{r makeQCCuts, results = "show"}
# Initialize cell tracking dataframe
# Get all starting barcodes before QC cuts
startingBarcodesList <- list()
subprojectList <- list()
for (i in seq_along(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
  poolName <- names(seuratObjects.tmp)[i]
  barcodesRaw <- colnames(seuratObjects.tmp[[i]])
  # Add pool prefix to match post-merge barcodes
  barcodesPrefixed <- paste0(poolName, "_", barcodesRaw)
  startingBarcodesList[[poolName]] <- barcodesPrefixed
  # Get subproject for this pool
  subprojectList[[poolName]] <- rep(seuratObjects.tmp[[i]]$subproject[1], length(barcodesPrefixed))
}
allStartingBarcodes <- unlist(startingBarcodesList)
allSubprojects <- unlist(subprojectList)

# Create tracking dataframe with pool and subproject info
cellFateTracking.df <- data.frame(
  barcode = allStartingBarcodes,
  pool = rep(names(startingBarcodesList),
    sapply(startingBarcodesList, length)),
  subproject = allSubprojects,
  stage_0_initial = 1,
  stage_1_pass_QC = 0,
  stage_2_pass_HT = 0,
  stage_3_pass_BCell = 0,
  stage_4_compartmentSplit = 0,
  finalCompartment = NA_character_,
  removedAtStage = NA_character_,
  removalReason = NA_character_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Initialized cell fate tracking for", length(allStartingBarcodes), "cells\n")
cat("  By subproject:\n")
print(table(cellFateTracking.df$subproject))

seuratQC.tmp <- vector("list", length(seuratObjects.tmp))
names(seuratQC.tmp) <- names(seuratObjects.tmp)

for (i in seq_along(seuratObjects.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratObjects.tmp[[i]]
  seuratQC.tmp[[i]] <- subset(
    seurat,
    subset = nFeature_RNA > nFeatureLow & nFeature_RNA < nFeatureHigh & percentMt < pctMt
  )
}

# Verify ATAC assay preserved through QC filtering
# Note: ATAC assay covers matched cells only (not all GEX cells), so its
# column count may differ from the RNA assay after QC subsetting.
cat("\nVerifying ATAC assay after QC filtering:\n")
for (i in seq_along(seuratQC.tmp)) {
  poolName <- names(seuratQC.tmp)[i]
  assays <- Assays(seuratQC.tmp[[i]])
  hasATACAssay <- "ATAC" %in% assays
  if (hasATACAssay) {
    nATACCells <- ncol(seuratQC.tmp[[i]][["ATAC"]])
    nRNACells <- ncol(seuratQC.tmp[[i]])
    cat(sprintf("  %s: ATAC assay present, %d peaks x %d ATAC cells (of %d total)\n",
      poolName, nrow(seuratQC.tmp[[i]][["ATAC"]]), nATACCells, nRNACells))
  } else {
    nWithFlag <- if ("hasATAC" %in% colnames(seuratQC.tmp[[i]]@meta.data))
      sum(seuratQC.tmp[[i]]$hasATAC, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
    cat(sprintf("  %s: No ATAC assay (hasATAC flag: %d cells)\n", poolName, nWithFlag))
  }
}

# Tally how many cells pass QC by pool
poolIds <- names(seuratObjects.tmp)
poolAnno <- data.frame(
  pool = poolIds,

}
```
