```{r programmaticHTODemux, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Fit two gaussians to find hashtag demultiplexing cutoffs
# For cases without a good high-expression peak, fit negative (left) population with single Gaussian, use mean+2*sd or 99th percentile as cutoff if GMM is poor, optionally use mclust for GMM
# requires mclust and mixtools
findHashtagCutoff <- function(x, featureName = NULL, poolName = NULL, plotDir = NULL) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x > 0]
  logx <- log1p(x)
  cutoff <- NA
  gmmOk <- FALSE
  negMu <- NA
  negSd <- NA
  posMu <- NA
  posSd <- NA

  if (length(logx) < 50) {
    cutoff <- NA
  } else {
    gmm <- try(Mclust(logx, G = 2, modelNames = "V"), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(gmm, "try-error") && !is.null(gmm$parameters$mean)) {
      mu <- sort(gmm$parameters$mean)
      sd <- sqrt(gmm$parameters$variance$sigmasq)
      # Lower threshold to 0.5 to allow GMM fitting for closer peaks
      if (abs(diff(mu)) > 0.5) {
        densX <- seq(min(logx), max(logx), length.out = 400)
        densY1 <- gmm$parameters$pro[1] * dnorm(densX, mu[1], sd[1])
        densY2 <- gmm$parameters$pro[2] * dnorm(densX, mu[2], sd[2])
        densY <- densY1 + densY2
        valleyRange <- densX[densX > mu[1] & densX < mu[2]]
        valleyY <- densY[densX > mu[1] & densX < mu[2]]
        if (length(valleyRange) > 5) {
          valley <- valleyRange[which.min(valleyY)]
          cutoff <- valley
          gmmOk <- TRUE
        }
      }
      negMu <- mu[1]
      posMu <- mu[2]
      negSd <- sd[1]
      posSd <- sd[2]
    }
    # Quantile/density minimum fallback if no positive peak
    if (!gmmOk) {
      d <- density(logx, bw = "nrd0")
      peakIdx <- which.max(d$y[d$x < median(logx)])
      negPeak <- d$x[d$x < median(logx)][peakIdx]
      rightLimit <- quantile(logx, 0.9995)
      idx <- which(d$x > negPeak & d$x < rightLimit)
      valley <- NA
      if (length(idx) > 5) {
        minIdx <- idx[which.min(d$y[idx])]
        valley <- d$x[minIdx]
      }
      # Negative population: left of midpoint between negPeak and max
      midpoint <- (negPeak + max(logx)) / 2
      negVals <- logx[logx < midpoint]
      q99_5 <- if (length(negVals) > 10) quantile(negVals, 0.99995) else quantile(logx, 0.99995)
      # Use min of quantile and density minimum, but only if valley > negPeak
      if (!is.na(valley) && valley > negPeak) {
        cutoff <- min(q99_5, valley)
      } else {
        cutoff <- q99_5
      }
    }
  }

  # Diagnostic plot
  if (!is.null(plotDir) && !is.null(featureName) && !is.null(poolName)) {
    plotFile <- file.path(plotDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_HashtagFit_", poolName, "_", featureName, ".pdf"))
    pdf(plotFile, width = 5, height = 4)
    hist(logx, breaks = 80, col = "grey90", border = "white", freq = FALSE, main = paste0("Hashtag fit: ", featureName, " (", poolName, ")"), xlab = "log1p(counts)")
    d <- density(logx, bw = "nrd0")
    lines(d, col = "purple", lwd = 2)
    if (!is.na(negMu) && !is.na(negSd)) {
      curve(dnorm(x, negMu, negSd), add = TRUE, col = "orange", lwd = 2, n = 400)
      abline(v = negMu, col = "orange", lty = 2)
      abline(v = negMu + 2 * negSd, col = "orange", lty = 3)
    }
    if (!is.na(posMu) && !is.na(posSd)) {
      curve(dnorm(x, posMu, posSd), add = TRUE, col = "green", lwd = 2, n = 400)
      abline(v = posMu, col = "green", lty = 2)
    }
    if (!is.na(cutoff)) abline(v = cutoff, col = "red", lwd = 2)
    legend("topright", legend = c("Density", "Neg fit", "Pos fit", "Cutoff"), col = c("purple", "orange", "green", "red"), lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1), lwd = c(2, 2, 2, 2), bty = "n")
    dev.off()
  }
  return(cutoff)
}

# For each pool, demultiplex using programmatic cutoffs
htDemuxResults <- list()
htCutoffList <- list()

# Demultiplexing loop:
for (i in seq_along(seuratQC.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratQC.tmp[[i]]
  poolName <- names(seuratQC.tmp)[i]
  htMat <- GetAssayData(seurat, assay = "HT", slot = "counts") # RAW counts
  htVars <- rownames(htMat)
  # log(count + 1) transformation, as in manual code
  logHtMat <- log(htMat + 1)
  cutoffs <- setNames(numeric(length(htVars)), htVars)
  longDiag <- list()
  fitOverlay <- list()
  for (j in seq_along(htVars)) {
    x <- as.numeric(logHtMat[htVars[j], ])
    xNonzero <- x[!is.na(x) & x > 0]
    cutoff <- NA
    gmmOk <- FALSE
    negMu <- NA
    negSd <- NA
    posMu <- NA
    posSd <- NA
    densX <- NULL
    densY <- NULL
    densY1 <- NULL
    densY2 <- NULL
    if (length(xNonzero) < 50) {
      cutoff <- NA
      cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Too few nonzero values (%d)\n", htVars[j], length(xNonzero)))
    } else {
      # Strategy: Use density peak detection first, then GMM with initialization
      # Use slightly wider bandwidth to smooth out single-count spikes
      d <- density(xNonzero, bw = "nrd0", adjust = 1.5)

      # Find local maxima in density with minimum height threshold
      findLocalMaxima <- function(y, minHeight = 0.05) {
        n <- length(y)
        maxima <- c()
        threshold <- max(y) * minHeight  # Peak must be at least 5% of max height
        for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
          if (y[i] > y[i - 1] && y[i] > y[i + 1] && y[i] > threshold) {
            maxima <- c(maxima, i)
          }
        }
        return(maxima)
      }

      peakIdx <- findLocalMaxima(d$y, minHeight = 0.1)  # Require 10% of max height
      peaks <- d$x[peakIdx]
      peakHeights <- d$y[peakIdx]

      # Find the dominant (negative) peak - usually the tallest on the left
      # But also ensure it's a substantial peak, not a spike
      leftPeaks <- peaks[peaks < median(xNonzero)]
      leftPeakHeights <- peakHeights[peaks < median(xNonzero)]
      if (length(leftPeaks) > 0) {
        # Pick the tallest left peak
        negPeakPos <- leftPeaks[which.max(leftPeakHeights)]
        negPeakHeight <- max(leftPeakHeights)
      } else {
        negPeakPos <- peaks[which.max(peakHeights)]
        negPeakHeight <- max(peakHeights)
      }

      # Look for a secondary peak to the right of the negative peak
      # Require at least 1.0 log unit separation for clear bimodality
      rightPeaks <- peaks[peaks > negPeakPos + 1.0]
      hasSecondPeak <- length(rightPeaks) > 0

      cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Found %d peaks (filtered), negPeak=%.2f (height=%.2f), rightPeaks=%d\n",
        htVars[j], length(peaks), negPeakPos, negPeakHeight, length(rightPeaks)))

      # Try GMM with G=1:2 to let it choose, or initialize with peak positions
      if (hasSecondPeak) {
        # Use the strongest right peak as positive peak estimate
        posPeakPos <- rightPeaks[which.max(d$y[d$x %in% rightPeaks])]

        # Try GMM with initialization based on detected peaks
        initMeans <- c(negPeakPos, posPeakPos)
        gmm <- try(Mclust(xNonzero, G = 2, modelNames = "V",
          initialization = list(subset = sample(length(xNonzero),
            min(length(xNonzero), 2000)))), silent = TRUE)

        if (!inherits(gmm, "try-error") && !is.null(gmm$parameters$mean)) {
          mu <- sort(gmm$parameters$mean)
          sd <- sqrt(gmm$parameters$variance$sigmasq)
          pro <- gmm$parameters$pro[order(gmm$parameters$mean)]
          cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: GMM fit mu1=%.2f (%.1f%%), mu2=%.2f (%.1f%%), sep=%.2f\n",
            htVars[j], mu[1], pro[1] * 100, mu[2], pro[2] * 100, abs(diff(mu))))

          if (abs(diff(mu)) > 0.5) {
            densX <- seq(min(xNonzero), max(xNonzero), length.out = 400)
            densY1 <- pro[1] * dnorm(densX, mu[1], sd[1])
            densY2 <- pro[2] * dnorm(densX, mu[2], sd[2])
            densY <- densY1 + densY2
            valleyRange <- densX[densX > mu[1] & densX < mu[2]]
            valleyY <- densY[densX > mu[1] & densX < mu[2]]
            if (length(valleyRange) > 5) {
              valley <- valleyRange[which.min(valleyY)]
              cutoff <- valley
              gmmOk <- TRUE
              negMu <- mu[1]
              posMu <- mu[2]
              negSd <- sd[1]
              posSd <- sd[2]
            }
          }
        }

        # If GMM failed but we detected peaks, use density minimum between them
        # But ensure the valley is at least 1.5 log units from negative peak
        if (!gmmOk) {
          cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Trying density valley between peaks (neg=%.2f, pos=%.2f)\n",
            htVars[j], negPeakPos, posPeakPos))
          # Only look for valley at least 1.0 log unit from negative peak
          valleySearchStart <- negPeakPos + 1.0
          valleyIdx <- which(d$x > valleySearchStart & d$x < posPeakPos)
          if (length(valleyIdx) > 3) {
            minIdx <- valleyIdx[which.min(d$y[valleyIdx])]
            cutoff <- d$x[minIdx]
            cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Found valley at %.2f\n", htVars[j], cutoff))
            gmmOk <- TRUE  # Mark as successful to skip quantile fallback
            # Estimate parameters from data split at valley
            negVals <- xNonzero[xNonzero < cutoff]
            posVals <- xNonzero[xNonzero >= cutoff]
            if (length(negVals) > 5) {
              negMu <- mean(negVals)
              negSd <- sd(negVals)
            }
            if (length(posVals) > 5) {
              posMu <- mean(posVals)
              posSd <- sd(posVals)
            }
            densX <- seq(min(xNonzero), max(xNonzero), length.out = 400)
            if (!is.na(negMu) && !is.na(negSd)) {
              densY1 <- dnorm(densX, negMu, negSd) * length(negVals) / length(xNonzero)
            }
            if (!is.na(posMu) && !is.na(posSd)) {
              densY2 <- dnorm(densX, posMu, posSd) * length(posVals) / length(xNonzero)
            }
            if (!is.null(densY1) && !is.null(densY2)) densY <- densY1 + densY2
          } else {
            cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Valley search range too narrow, skipping\n", htVars[j]))
          }
        }
      }

      # Fallback: look for density minimum even without clear secondary peak
      if (!gmmOk) {
        # Check if there are cells in the right tail that might be positive
        # Even if not enough to form a peak, find where density drops to minimum
        # Search starting at least 1.5 log units from negative peak
        rightOfPeak <- d$x > negPeakPos + 1.5
        if (sum(rightOfPeak) > 10) {
          # Find the global minimum in density to the right of negative peak
          minIdx <- which(rightOfPeak)[which.min(d$y[rightOfPeak])]
          densityMin <- d$x[minIdx]

          # Check if there are cells beyond this minimum (indicating positive population)
          cellsBeyondMin <- sum(xNonzero > densityMin)
          cellsBeforeMin <- sum(xNonzero <= densityMin)

          cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Density min at %.2f, cells before=%d, after=%d\n",
            htVars[j], densityMin, cellsBeforeMin, cellsBeyondMin))

          # If at least 5% of cells are beyond the minimum, use it as cutoff
          if (cellsBeyondMin > length(xNonzero) * 0.05 && cellsBeyondMin > 20) {
            cutoff <- densityMin
            gmmOk <- TRUE
            cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Using density minimum as cutoff\n", htVars[j]))

            # Estimate parameters
            negVals <- xNonzero[xNonzero < cutoff]
            posVals <- xNonzero[xNonzero >= cutoff]
            if (length(negVals) > 5) {
              negMu <- mean(negVals)
              negSd <- sd(negVals)
            }
            if (length(posVals) > 5) {
              posMu <- mean(posVals)
              posSd <- sd(posVals)
            }
            densX <- seq(min(xNonzero), max(xNonzero), length.out = 400)
            if (!is.na(negMu) && !is.na(negSd)) {
              densY1 <- dnorm(densX, negMu, negSd) * length(negVals) / length(xNonzero)
            }
            if (!is.na(posMu) && !is.na(posSd)) {
              densY2 <- dnorm(densX, posMu, posSd) * length(posVals) / length(xNonzero)
            }
            if (!is.null(densY1) && !is.null(densY2)) densY <- densY1 + densY2
          }
        }
      }

      # Final fallback: use quantile of negative population
      if (!gmmOk) {
        cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Using quantile fallback\n", htVars[j]))
        # Fit to left side of distribution (negative population)
        midpoint <- negPeakPos + 1.5  # Assume positive starts ~1.5 log units from neg peak
        negVals <- xNonzero[xNonzero < midpoint]

        if (length(negVals) > 10) {
          negMu <- mean(negVals)
          negSd <- sd(negVals)
          # Cutoff at mean + 4*SD of negative population, or 99.9th percentile
          # Use higher multiplier to clear the tail of sharp-peaked distributions
          cutoff <- max(negMu + 4 * negSd, quantile(negVals, 0.999))
          cat(sprintf("  [Debug] %s: Fallback cutoff: negMu=%.2f, negSd=%.2f, cutoff=%.2f\n",
            htVars[j], negMu, negSd, cutoff))
        } else {
          cutoff <- quantile(xNonzero, 0.999)
        }

        densX <- seq(min(xNonzero), max(xNonzero), length.out = 400)
        if (!is.na(negMu) && !is.na(negSd)) {
          densY1 <- dnorm(densX, negMu, negSd)
        }
        densY2 <- NA_real_
        densY <- NA_real_
        posMu <- NA_real_
        posSd <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    cutoffs[j] <- cutoff
    cat(sprintf("[Demux] Pool: %s | Hashtag: %s | Cutoff: %.4f\n", poolName, htVars[j], cutoff))
    if (length(xNonzero) > 0) {
      longDiag[[j]] <- tibble::tibble(ht = htVars[j], logx = xNonzero, cutoff = cutoff)
    }
    fitOverlay[[j]] <- tibble::tibble(
      ht = htVars[j],
      densX = densX,
      densY = densY,
      densY1 = densY1,
      densY2 = densY2,
      negMu = negMu,
      negSd = negSd,
      posMu = posMu,
      posSd = posSd
    )
  }
  diagDf <- dplyr::bind_rows(longDiag)
  if (length(fitOverlay) > 0) {
    overlayDf <- dplyr::bind_rows(fitOverlay)
  } else {
    overlayDf <- tibble::tibble(ht = htVars, densX = NA_real_, densY = NA_real_, densY1 = NA_real_, densY2 = NA_real_, negMu = NA_real_, negSd = NA_real_, posMu = NA_real_, posSd = NA_real_)
  }
  htCutoffList[[poolName]] <- cutoffs
  # Assign calls: apply cutoffs to log(count+1) as in manual code
  htDf <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(logHtMat)))
  colnames(htDf) <- htVars
  nCells <- rowSums(sweep(htDf, 2, cutoffs, ">"), na.rm = TRUE)
  call <- rep("Negative", nrow(htDf))
  call[nCells > 1] <- "Multiplet"
  for (j in seq_along(htVars)) {
    idx <- which(call == "Negative" & htDf[[htVars[j]]] > cutoffs[j])
    call[idx] <- htVars[j]
  }
  htDf$demuxCall <- call
  htDemuxResults[[poolName]] <- htDf
  # Print summary of demux calls for this pool
  cat(sprintf("\n[Demux Summary] Pool: %s\n", poolName))
  callCounts <- table(factor(htDf$demuxCall, levels = c(htVars, "Negative", "Multiplet")))
  print(as.data.frame(callCounts), row.names = FALSE)
  # Multi-panel diagnostic plot: all hashtags in one figure per pool
  cutoffDf <- tibble::tibble(ht = names(cutoffs), cutoff = as.numeric(cutoffs))
  nrowFacet <- 5
  ncolFacet <- 3
  pDiag <- ggplot(diagDf, aes(x = logx)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 80, fill = "grey80") +
    geom_line(data = overlayDf, aes(x = densX, y = densY), color = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(data = overlayDf, aes(x = densX, y = densY1), color = "orange", linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(data = overlayDf, aes(x = densX, y = densY2), color = "green", linetype = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(data = cutoffDf, aes(xintercept = cutoff), color = "red") +
    facet_wrap(~ht, scales = "free_y", nrow = nrowFacet, ncol = ncolFacet) +
    labs(title = paste0("Hashtag fits & cutoffs: ", poolName), x = "log1p(counts)", y = "Density")

  savePlot(
    plot = pDiag,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0("HashtagFits_", poolName),
    height = 10,
    width = 15,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # Add htDemux to the current seurat object for ridgeplot
  seurat$htDemux <- call

  # Ridgeplot for each pool (all hashtags, grouped by demux call, one plot per feature, combined)
  DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "HT"
  plots <- list()
  for (feature in htVars) {
    p <- RidgePlot(seurat,
      assay = "HT",
      features = feature,
      group.by = "htDemux",
      slot = "data") +
      labs(x = "Hashtag expression", y = "Assigned demux group") +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 0.5)) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    plots[[feature]] <- p
  }
  combinedPlot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)

  savePlot(
    plot = combinedPlot,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0("Ridgeplots_HTExpression_", poolName),
    height = 20,
    width = 30,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )
}


# Merge demux calls into meta.data for each seurat object
for (i in seq_along(seuratQC.tmp)) {
  seurat <- seuratQC.tmp[[i]]
  poolName <- names(seuratQC.tmp)[i]
  calls <- htDemuxResults[[poolName]]$demuxCall
  seurat$htDemux <- calls
  seuratQC.tmp[[i]] <- seurat
}

# Merge all pools after demux (both subprojects)
cat("\nMerging all pools from both subprojects...\n")
if (length(seuratQC.tmp) > 1) {
  seuratQCMerged <- merge(
    seuratQC.tmp[[1]],
    y = seuratQC.tmp[-1],
    add.cell.ids = names(seuratQC.tmp),
    merge.data = TRUE
  )
} else {
  seuratQCMerged <- seuratQC.tmp[[1]]
}

DefaultAssay(seuratQCMerged) <- "HT"

# Verify ATAC assay preserved through merge
# After merge, ATAC assay covers the union of matched cells across pools.
# Column count will be smaller than RNA if some cells lack ATAC.
cat("\nVerifying ATAC assay after merge:\n")
assays <- Assays(seuratQCMerged)
cat("  Assays present:", paste(assays, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if ("ATAC" %in% assays) {
  nATACFeatures <- nrow(seuratQCMerged[["ATAC"]])
  nATACCells <- ncol(seuratQCMerged[["ATAC"]])
  cat(sprintf("  ATAC assay: %d peaks x %d cells (%.1f%% of %d total)\n",
    nATACFeatures, nATACCells, 100 * nATACCells / ncol(seuratQCMerged),
    ncol(seuratQCMerged)))
} else {
  cat("  ATAC assay not present after merge (expected if pools had no ATAC)\n")
}

# Print final summary
cat("\nFinal merged object summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total cells: %d\n", ncol(seuratQCMerged)))
cat(sprintf("  Total features: %d\n", nrow(seuratQCMerged)))
cat("\n  Cells by subproject:\n")
print(table(seuratQCMerged$subproject))
cat("\n  Cells by pool:\n")
print(table(seuratQCMerged$pool))
cat("\n  HTO demux summary:\n")
print(table(seuratQCMerged$htDemux))

# Check for ATAC availability
if ("hasATAC" %in% colnames(seuratQCMerged@meta.data)) {
  cat("\n  ATAC availability:\n")
  print(table(seuratQCMerged$subproject, seuratQCMerged$hasATAC))
}

gc()
```

```{r hashtagUMAP}
# visualize the HT expression on a UMAP plot

# set default assay to HT (will reset to RNA later)
DefaultAssay(seuratQCMerged) <- "HT"

# Get the names of the hashtags
htVariables <- rownames(seuratQCMerged)
seuratQCMerged <- ScaleData(seuratQCMerged, features = rownames(htVariables),
  verbose = FALSE)
seuratQCMerged <- RunPCA(seuratQCMerged, features = htVariables, approx = FALSE)

# look at an elbow plot to determine the number of dims to use for findneighbors and runumap
# looks like 12 is good
p.tmp <- ElbowPlot(seuratQCMerged)
print(p.tmp)

# Find neighbors and clusters
seuratQCMerged <- FindNeighbors(seuratQCMerged, dims = 1:12)
clusterResolution <- c("HT" = 0.3, "RNA" = 0.3)
seuratQCMerged <- FindClusters(seuratQCMerged, resolution = clusterResolution["HT"])

seuratQCMerged <- RunUMAP(seuratQCMerged, dims = 1:12)

# store cluster info in seurat object metadata
```

```{r addAnnoToSeurat}
# Now that we've demultiplexed by hashtag, we can add annotation metadata to the Seurat object
# htDemux values have format like "Subject-001-5" or "Subject 006-0" (inconsistent spacing/dashes)
# Need to extract donorID (middle number, removing leading zeros) and visitNum (last number)

# Extract Seurat metadata
metadata.tmp <- seuratQCMerged@meta.data

# Parse htDemux to extract donorID and visitNum
# Handle both "Subject-NNN-V" and "Subject NNN-V" formats
metadata.tmp$donorID <- NA_character_
metadata.tmp$visitNum <- NA_character_

# Extract for non-Negative/Multiplet cells
validCells <- !metadata.tmp$htDemux %in% c("Negative", "Multiplet")
if (sum(validCells) > 0) {
  # Remove spaces and standardize to dash-separated format
  htClean <- gsub("\\s+", "-", metadata.tmp$htDemux[validCells])

  # Extract the last two numeric components (subject ID and visit number)
  # Pattern: Subject-NNN-V where NNN is donor (with leading zeros) and V is visit
  parts <- str_match(htClean, "Subject-?(\\d+)-(\\d+)$")

  # parts[,2] is the donor ID (may have leading zeros), parts[,3] is visit number
  # Convert through integer to remove leading zeros, then back to character
  metadata.tmp$donorID[validCells] <- as.character(as.integer(parts[, 2]))
  metadata.tmp$visitNum[validCells] <- as.character(as.integer(parts[, 3]))
}

cat("Parsed htDemux values:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Unique donorIDs: %s\n", paste(sort(unique(metadata.tmp$donorID[!is.na(metadata.tmp$donorID)])), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  Unique visitNums: %s\n", paste(sort(unique(metadata.tmp$visitNum[!is.na(metadata.tmp$visitNum)])), collapse = ", ")))

# Prepare annotation data for joining - ensure type compatibility
annoP697.tmp <- annoP697 %>%
  mutate(
    donorID = as.character(as.integer(donorID)),  # Remove leading zeros, keep as character
    visitNum = as.character(as.integer(visitNum))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(donorID, visitNum, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("\nAnnotation data: %d unique donorID-visitNum combinations\n", nrow(annoP697.tmp)))
cat(sprintf("  Annotation donorID type: %s\n", class(annoP697.tmp$donorID)))
cat(sprintf("  Annotation visitNum type: %s\n", class(annoP697.tmp$visitNum)))

# Join metadata with annotation based on donorID and visitNum
metaJoined.tmp <- dplyr::left_join(
  metadata.tmp,
  annoP697.tmp,
  by = c("donorID", "visitNum"),
  suffix = c("", "_anno")
)
rownames(metaJoined.tmp) <- rownames(metadata.tmp)

# Check join success
nJoined <- sum(!is.na(metaJoined.tmp$donorID) & !metaJoined.tmp$htDemux %in% c("Negative", "Multiplet"))
cat(sprintf("Successfully joined annotation for %d / %d cells with hashtag assignments\n",
  nJoined, sum(validCells)))

# Overwrite meta.data
seuratQCMerged@meta.data <- metaJoined.tmp

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
gc()
```

```{r removeHTMultipletsAndNegatives}
# subset seuratQCMerged to remove $htDemux %in% c("multiplet", "negative")
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- subset(seuratQCMerged, subset = !(htDemux %in% c("Multiplet", "Negative")))

# removed 13792 cells (6248 Multiplets and 7544 Negatives)
dim(seuratQCMerged) # 27715 81923
dim(seuratQCMergedCleaned) # 21372 68131

# Update cell fate tracking for hashtag demux step
# Mark cells that passed HT demux (in seuratQCMergedCleaned)
ht_passed_barcodes <- colnames(seuratQCMergedCleaned)
cellFateTracking.df$stage_2_pass_HT[cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% ht_passed_barcodes] <- 1

# Find cells removed by HT demux: passed QC but not in cleaned object
merged_barcodes <- colnames(seuratQCMerged)
ht_removed <- cellFateTracking.df$stage_1_pass_QC == 1 &
  cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% merged_barcodes &
  !cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% ht_passed_barcodes

# Identify specific HT removal reason from metadata
if (any(ht_removed)) {
  ht_meta <- seuratQCMerged@meta.data
  ht_meta$barcode <- rownames(ht_meta)
  ht_removed_barcodes <- cellFateTracking.df$barcode[ht_removed]

  for (bc in ht_removed_barcodes) {
    if (bc %in% ht_meta$barcode) {
      ht_call <- ht_meta$htDemux[ht_meta$barcode == bc]
      cellFateTracking.df$removed_at_stage[cellFateTracking.df$barcode == bc] <- "Stage_2_HT_demux"
      cellFateTracking.df$removal_reason[cellFateTracking.df$barcode == bc] <-
        paste0("HT_", ht_call)
    }
  }
}

cat("\nCell fate after hashtag demux:\n")
cat("  Passed HT demux:", sum(cellFateTracking.df$stage_2_pass_HT), "\n")
cat("  Removed at HT demux:", sum(ht_removed), "\n")
cat("    Multiplets:", sum(grepl("Multiplet", cellFateTracking.df$removal_reason,
  ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("    Negatives:", sum(grepl("Negative", cellFateTracking.df$removal_reason,
  ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# remove seuratQCMerged--we don't need it anymore
rm(seuratQCMerged)
```

```{r reProcessCleanedData}
# Re-run normalization, clustering, UMAP, etc on this subset
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- JoinLayers(seuratQCMergedCleaned, assay = "RNA")

DefaultAssay(seuratQCMergedCleaned) <- "RNA"
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- NormalizeData(object = seuratQCMergedCleaned, verbose = FALSE, assay = "RNA")

seuratQCMergedCleaned <- NormalizeData(object = seuratQCMergedCleaned,
  verbose = FALSE,
  normalization.method = "CLR",
  margin = 2,
  assay = "HT")

seuratQCMergedCleaned <- FindVariableFeatures(object = seuratQCMergedCleaned,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2001, # we normally use 2000, but we're dropping the TCR genes in the next step, and there was 1 TCR genes in the variable features, so we're now asking for 2111
  verbose = FALSE)

VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned) <- setdiff(
  VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned),
  tcrGeneList %>% stats::na.omit() %>% unique()
)

seuratQCMergedCleaned <- ScaleData(
  object = seuratQCMergedCleaned,
  verbose = FALSE,
  features = VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned)
)
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- RunPCA(object = seuratQCMergedCleaned, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

# Elbow plot
elbowPlot.tmp <- ElbowPlot(seuratQCMergedCleaned)

pdf(file.path(plotDir,
  paste0(filenameSuffix, "_elbowPlotUMAP.pdf")),

set.seed(6022)
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- RunUMAP(object = seuratQCMergedCleaned, reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:11,
  n.neighbors = 30,
  min.dist = 0.3,
```

```{r loadCellTypistResultsAndAddToSeurat}
# Load CellTypist predictions for all levels (L1, L2, L3) using a loop
cellTypist_levels <- c("L1", "L2", "L3")

# TODO move this further up
seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data$barcode <- rownames(seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data)

# Get Seurat barcodes once
seuratBarcodes <- seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data$barcode

for (level in cellTypist_levels) {
  # Construct filename for current level
  filename <- paste0("20260204_P697_celltypist_", level, "_predictions.csv")
  filepath <- file.path(dataOutputDir, filename)

  # Check if file exists before trying to load it
  if (file.exists(filepath)) {
    cat("Loading CellTypist", level, "predictions...\n")

    # Load the cellTypist output
    cellTypist.df <- read.csv(filepath) %>% data.frame()

    # Extract barcodes from cellTypist.df
    cellTypistBarcodes <- cellTypist.df$X

    # Match barcodes and create a named vector for majority_voting
    matchingIndices <- match(seuratBarcodes, cellTypistBarcodes)
    cellTypistCalling <- cellTypist.df$majority_voting[matchingIndices]

    # Create column name
    colName <- paste0("cellTypistCalling", level)

    # Add cellTypistCalling to seuratQCMergedCleaned metadata
    seuratQCMergedCleaned <- Seurat::AddMetaData(
      object = seuratQCMergedCleaned,
      metadata = cellTypistCalling,
      col.name = colName
    )

    # Replace NA values with "Other"
    seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data[[colName]][is.na(seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data[[colName]])] <- "Other"

    # Create color palette for this level
    unique_cell_types <- sort(unique(seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data[[colName]]))
    n_colors <- length(unique_cell_types)

    # Generate colorblind-friendly palette
    palette_colors <- big_colorblind_pal(n_colors = n_colors)

    # Create named palette
    palette_name <- paste0("palCellTypist", level)
    assign(palette_name, setNames(palette_colors, unique_cell_types))

    cat("Successfully added", colName, "to Seurat object\n")
    cat("Created color palette", palette_name, "with", n_colors, "colors\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: File", filepath, "not found. Skipping", level, "predictions.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r identifyPotentialBCells}
  group.by = "cellTypistCallingL3",
  cols = palCellTypistL3,
  shuffle = TRUE,
  pt.size = 1
) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", color = "CellTypist", title = "") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
savePlot(
  plot = plot.tmp,
  plotDir = plotDir,
  filename = paste0("UMAP_RNA_cellTypistL3"),
  height = 6,
  width = 10,

# It looks like we can exclude cells with UMAP 2 greater than 6.
# Let's find those barcodes, determine which donor/stim they are all from, and then remove them from
# the Seurat object

# Identify and remove cells with UMAP_2 > 6
umapCoords.tmp <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(seuratQCMergedCleaned, reduction = "umap"))
colnames(umapCoords.tmp) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
umapCoords.tmp$barcode <- rownames(umapCoords.tmp)

# Find barcodes to exclude
excludeBarcodes.tmp <- umapCoords.tmp %>%
  dplyr::filter(UMAP_2 > 6) %>%
  dplyr::pull(barcode)
length(excludeBarcodes.tmp) # 227

# save excluded barcodes
write.csv(excludeBarcodes.tmp, file.path(dataOutputDir, "barcodesSuspectedBCellsOrDCsToExclude.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Report donorID and visitNum for these barcodes
metaExclude.tmp <- seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data[excludeBarcodes.tmp, c("donorID", "visitNum"), drop = FALSE]
cat("Barcodes to exclude (UMAP_1 < -7 | UMAP_2 > 10):\n")
print(data.frame(barcode = excludeBarcodes.tmp, metaExclude.tmp))
# Print summary table: counts per donor split by visit
cat("\nSummary of excluded cells (counts per donor x visit):\n")
excludeCountsTable.tmp <- table(metaExclude.tmp$donorID, metaExclude.tmp$visitNum)
print(excludeCountsTable.tmp)

# save excluded counts table
write.csv(excludeCountsTable.tmp, file.path(dataOutputDir, "countsSuspectedBCellsOrDCsToExclude.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Remove these cells from the Seurat object
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- subset(seuratQCMergedCleaned, cells = excludeBarcodes.tmp, invert = TRUE)

# Update cell fate tracking for B cell removal step
bcell_passed_barcodes <- colnames(seuratQCMergedCleaned)
cellFateTracking.df$stage_3_pass_BCell[cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% bcell_passed_barcodes] <- 1

# Mark cells removed by B cell filtering
bcell_removed <- cellFateTracking.df$stage_2_pass_HT == 1 &
  cellFateTracking.df$stage_3_pass_BCell == 0

cellFateTracking.df$removed_at_stage[bcell_removed] <- "Stage_3_BCell_removal"
cellFateTracking.df$removal_reason[bcell_removed] <- "Suspected_BCell_or_DC"

cat("\nCell fate after B cell removal:\n")
cat("  Passed B cell filter:", sum(cellFateTracking.df$stage_3_pass_BCell), "\n")
cat("  Removed as B cells/DCs:", sum(bcell_removed), "\n")

# Remove these cells from the Seurat object
seuratQCMergedCleaned <- subset(seuratQCMergedCleaned, cells = excludeBarcodes.tmp, invert = TRUE)


rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
```

```{r integrateByDonor}
################################################## PCA/clustering
# This will split the data by DonorID
seuratQCSplitCleaned <- split(seuratQCMergedCleaned, f = seuratQCMergedCleaned$donorID)

# Normalize and PCA
seuratQCSplitCleaned <- NormalizeData(seuratQCSplitCleaned, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", assay = "RNA")
VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned) <- setdiff(
  VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned),
  tcrGeneList %>% stats::na.omit() %>% unique()
)

seuratQCSplitCleaned <- ScaleData(seuratQCSplitCleaned, assay = "RNA")
seuratQCSplitCleaned <- RunPCA(seuratQCSplitCleaned, assay = "RNA", npcs = 30)

################################################## PCA/clustering
# Integration by CCA/MNN
seuratSplitIntegrated <- IntegrateLayers(object = seuratQCSplitCleaned, method = HarmonyIntegration, assay = "RNA",
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony", verbose = T)
seuratMergedIntegrated <- JoinLayers(seuratSplitIntegrated)

# Verify ATAC assay preserved through integration
# ATAC covers matched cells only; its column count tracks through merge/integration.
cat("\nVerifying ATAC assay after Harmony integration:\n")
assays <- Assays(seuratMergedIntegrated)
cat("  Assays present:", paste(assays, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if ("ATAC" %in% assays) {
  nATACFeatures <- nrow(seuratMergedIntegrated[["ATAC"]])
  nATACCells <- ncol(seuratMergedIntegrated[["ATAC"]])
  cat(sprintf("  ATAC assay: %d peaks x %d cells (%.1f%% of %d total)\n",
    nATACFeatures, nATACCells, 100 * nATACCells / ncol(seuratMergedIntegrated),
    ncol(seuratMergedIntegrated)))
  cat("  Note: RNA integrated via Harmony; ATAC remains unintegrated (expected)\n")
  nFrags <- length(Fragments(seuratMergedIntegrated[["ATAC"]]))
  cat(sprintf("  Fragment files linked: %d\n", nFrags))
} else {
  cat("  ATAC assay not present after integration\n")
  if ("hasATAC" %in% colnames(seuratMergedIntegrated@meta.data)) {
    cat(sprintf("  hasATAC flag: %d cells\n",
      sum(seuratMergedIntegrated$hasATAC, na.rm = TRUE)))
  }
}
```

```{r separateTregFromNKCells}
# Get UMAP coordinates

# Identify NK barcodes (UMAP_1 < 0)

# Save compartment barcodes

write.csv(nkBarcodes.tmp, file.path(dataOutputDir, "barcodesNKCompartment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Report donorID and visitNum for Treg cells
metaTreg.tmp <- seuratMergedIntegrated@meta.data[tregBarcodes.tmp, c("donorID", "visitNum"), drop = FALSE]
cat("Treg compartment (UMAP_1 > 0):\n")

cat("\nSummary of Treg cells (counts per donor x visit):\n")
tregCountsTable.tmp <- table(metaTreg.tmp$donorID, metaTreg.tmp$visitNum)
print(tregCountsTable.tmp)
write.csv(tregCountsTable.tmp, file.path(dataOutputDir, "countsTregCompartment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Report donorID and visitNum for NK cells
metaNK.tmp <- seuratMergedIntegrated@meta.data[nkBarcodes.tmp, c("donorID", "visitNum"), drop = FALSE]
cat("\nNK compartment (UMAP_1 < 0):\n")
cat("Total NK cells:", length(nkBarcodes.tmp), "\n")
cat("\nSummary of NK cells (counts per donor x visit):\n")
nkCountsTable.tmp <- table(metaNK.tmp$donorID, metaNK.tmp$visitNum)
print(nkCountsTable.tmp)
write.csv(nkCountsTable.tmp, file.path(dataOutputDir, "countsNKCompartment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Create separate Seurat objects for Treg and NK compartments
seuratTreg <- subset(seuratMergedIntegrated, cells = tregBarcodes.tmp)
seuratNK <- subset(seuratMergedIntegrated, cells = nkBarcodes.tmp)

# Update cell fate tracking for compartment split (stage 4)
# Mark all cells that passed B cell filter as reaching stage 4
cellFateTracking.df$stage_4_compartmentSplit <- 0
all_compartment_barcodes <- c(tregBarcodes.tmp, nkBarcodes.tmp)
cellFateTracking.df$stage_4_compartmentSplit[cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% all_compartment_barcodes] <- 1

# Assign finalCompartment for cells that made it to this stage
cellFateTracking.df$finalCompartment[cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% tregBarcodes.tmp] <- "Treg"
cellFateTracking.df$finalCompartment[cellFateTracking.df$barcode %in% nkBarcodes.tmp] <- "NK"

cat("\nCell fate after compartment split:\n")
cat("  Assigned to Treg compartment:", sum(cellFateTracking.df$finalCompartment == "Treg", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Assigned to NK compartment:", sum(cellFateTracking.df$finalCompartment == "NK", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Summary of cells in each object
cat("\nFinal Seurat object sizes:\n")
cat("  seuratTreg:", ncol(seuratTreg), "cells\n")
cat("  seuratNK:", ncol(seuratNK), "cells\n")

# Verify ATAC assay in compartment-split objects
# ATAC covers matched cells only, so ncol(ATAC) <= ncol(obj)
cat("\nVerifying ATAC assay after compartment split:\n")
for (objName in c("seuratTreg", "seuratNK")) {
  obj <- get(objName)
  assays <- Assays(obj)
  cat(sprintf("\n  %s:\n", objName))
  cat("    Assays present:", paste(assays, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  if ("ATAC" %in% assays) {
    nATACFeatures <- nrow(obj[["ATAC"]])
    nATACCells <- ncol(obj[["ATAC"]])
    cat(sprintf("    ATAC: %d peaks x %d cells (%.1f%% of %d total)\n",
      nATACFeatures, nATACCells, 100 * nATACCells / ncol(obj), ncol(obj)))

    nFrags <- length(Fragments(obj[["ATAC"]]))
    cat(sprintf("    Fragment files linked: %d\n", nFrags))
  } else {
    nWithFlag <- if ("hasATAC" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
      sum(obj$hasATAC, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
    cat(sprintf("    ATAC assay not present (hasATAC flag: %d cells)\n", nWithFlag))
  }
}
```

```{r atacQCSummary}
# Comprehensive ATAC QC Summary for Treg and NK compartments
# ATAC assay covers matched cells only (not zero-padded to all cells).
# ncol(ATAC) = number of cells with ATAC data; ncol(obj) = total GEX cells.
# Detailed ATAC-specific QC (TSS enrichment, nucleosome signal) should be
# performed in downstream analysis scripts using Signac functions.

cat("\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
cat("ATAC Data Integration Summary\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")

atacSummary <- data.frame(
  Compartment = character(),
  Total_Cells = integer(),
  Cells_With_ATAC = integer(),
  Pct_With_ATAC = numeric(),
  Total_Peaks = integer(),
  Peaks_Detected = integer(),
  Mean_Peaks_Per_Cell = numeric(),
  Median_Peaks_Per_Cell = numeric(),
  Fragment_Files = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (objName in c("seuratTreg", "seuratNK")) {
  obj <- get(objName)
  compartmentName <- sub("seurat", "", objName)
  nTotalCells <- ncol(obj)

  if ("ATAC" %in% Assays(obj)) {
    atacAssay <- obj[["ATAC"]]
    nATACCells <- ncol(atacAssay)
    pctWithATAC <- 100 * nATACCells / nTotalCells
    nTotalPeaks <- nrow(atacAssay)

    # Compute per-cell peak counts (ATAC assay is matched-cells-only, so all
    # columns have real data — no need to filter peakCountsPerCell > 0)
    peakCountsPerCell <- colSums(atacAssay@counts)
    nPeaksDetected <- sum(rowSums(atacAssay@counts) > 0)
    meanPeaksPerCell <- mean(peakCountsPerCell)
    medianPeaksPerCell <- median(peakCountsPerCell)
    nFragFiles <- length(Fragments(atacAssay))

    atacSummary <- rbind(atacSummary, data.frame(
      Compartment = compartmentName,
      Total_Cells = nTotalCells,
      Cells_With_ATAC = nATACCells,
      Pct_With_ATAC = round(pctWithATAC, 1),
      Total_Peaks = nTotalPeaks,
      Peaks_Detected = nPeaksDetected,
      Mean_Peaks_Per_Cell = round(meanPeaksPerCell, 0),
      Median_Peaks_Per_Cell = round(medianPeaksPerCell, 0),
      Fragment_Files = nFragFiles,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))

    cat(sprintf("\n%s Compartment:\n", compartmentName))
    cat(sprintf("  Total cells (GEX): %d\n", nTotalCells))
    cat(sprintf("  Cells with ATAC: %d (%.1f%%)\n", nATACCells, pctWithATAC))
    cat(sprintf("  Peaks: %d total, %d detected (%.1f%%)\n",
      nTotalPeaks, nPeaksDetected, 100 * nPeaksDetected / nTotalPeaks))
    cat(sprintf("  Peaks per cell: mean %.0f, median %.0f\n", meanPeaksPerCell, medianPeaksPerCell))
    cat(sprintf("  Fragment files linked: %d\n", nFragFiles))
  } else {
    atacSummary <- rbind(atacSummary, data.frame(
      Compartment = compartmentName,
      Total_Cells = nTotalCells,
      Cells_With_ATAC = 0,
      Pct_With_ATAC = 0,
      Total_Peaks = 0,
      Peaks_Detected = 0,
      Mean_Peaks_Per_Cell = 0,
      Median_Peaks_Per_Cell = 0,
      Fragment_Files = 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    cat(sprintf("\n%s Compartment: No ATAC assay present\n", compartmentName))
  }
}

cat("\n")
cat("Summary Table:\n")
print(atacSummary, row.names = FALSE)

# Save summary table
write.csv(atacSummary,
  file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0("ATAC_integration_summary_", filenameSuffix, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n")
cat("ATAC data integrated into Seurat objects (matched cells only).\n")
cat("For downstream multimodal / DA analysis, objects contain:\n")
cat("  - ChromatinAssay with peak counts (matched cells)\n")
cat("  - Linked fragment files (5-column, bgzipped + tabix indexed)\n")
cat("  - Genome annotations (hg38, EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)\n")
cat("  - hasATAC metadata flag on all cells\n")
cat("\nRecommended downstream analyses (separate script):\n")
cat("  - TSS enrichment and nucleosome signal (Signac QC)\n")
cat("  - Differential accessibility testing\n")
cat("  - Peak-to-gene linking\n")
cat("  - WNN multimodal integration (RNA + ATAC)\n")
cat("  - TF motif enrichment\n")
cat("  - Gene activity scores\n")
cat("  - Chromatin accessibility footprinting\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 70), "\\n", sep = "")
```

```{r subClusterTregs}
# Re-run normalization, clustering, UMAP, etc on this subset
DefaultAssay(seuratTreg) <- "RNA"
seuratTreg <- JoinLayers(seuratTreg, layers = c("RNA"))
seuratQCSplitCleaned <- NormalizeData(seuratQCSplitCleaned, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", assay = "RNA")

seuratTreg <- NormalizeData(object = seuratTreg,
  verbose = FALSE,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  margin = 2,
  assay = "HT")

VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned) <- setdiff(
  VariableFeatures(seuratQCMergedCleaned),
  tcrGeneList %>% stats::na.omit() %>% unique()
)

seuratTreg <- ScaleData(object = seuratTreg, verbose = FALSE)
seuratTreg <- RunPCA(object = seuratTreg, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

# Elbow plot
elbowPlot.tmp <- ElbowPlot(seuratTreg, reduction = "pca")

pdf(file.path(plotDir,
  paste0(filenameSuffix, "_elbowPlotUMAP.pdf")),
height = 5,
width = 6)

print(elbowPlot.tmp)

dev.off()
rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)

# # Here, we should test if the opt param file exists and if not, default to seurat param defaults...
# nClusters <- 7

# # load the optimal hyperparameters for nClusters from the cluster optimization run
# # User-provided path to the saved optimization results (copy/paste as needed)
# optParamFile <- file.path(dataOutputDir, "20251024_allCellsClusterAndProjectionOptHyperparameters.csv")

# # Read and select parameters for the requested nClusters
# optParams.df <- read.csv(optParamFile, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# optRow <- optParams.df[optParams.df$nClusters == nClusters, , drop = FALSE]
# optRow <- optRow[1, , drop = FALSE]

# # Extract hyperparameters
# findNeighborsDim <- as.integer(optRow$findNeighborsDim[[1]])
# findClustersRes <- as.numeric(optRow$findClustersRes[[1]])
# min.dist <- as.numeric(optRow$min.dist[[1]])
# n_neighbors <- as.integer(optRow$n_neighbors[[1]])

# tmp until we optimize
findNeighborsDim <- 18
findClustersRes <- 0.3
n_neighbors <- 30
min.dist <- 0.3

# These are the hyperparameters for the 'optimal' clustering with nClusters clusters
set.seed(6022)
seuratTreg <- FindNeighbors(seuratTreg, dims = 1:findNeighborsDim, reduction = "harmony")
seuratTreg <- FindClusters(seuratTreg, resolution = findClustersRes, reduction = "harmony")

set.seed(6022)
seuratTreg <- RunUMAP(object = seuratTreg,
  reduction = "harmony",
  return.model = TRUE,
  dims = 1:findNeighborsDim,
  n.neighbors = n_neighbors,
  min.dist = min.dist)

# store cluster info in seurat object metadata
# Initialize clusterName and clusterMarkers
clusterName <- character()
clusterMarkers <- list()

# Create the cluster name for RNA
clusterName[["RNA"]] <- paste0("seurat_clusters_RNA_", str_replace(clusterResolution[["RNA"]], "\\.", "p"))

# Add metadata to the Seurat object
seuratTreg <- seuratTreg %>%
  Seurat::AddMetaData(Idents(seuratTreg), col.name = clusterName[["RNA"]])

# Set the identifiers
Idents(seuratTreg) <- seuratTreg@meta.data[[clusterName[["RNA"]]]]

# Ensure data layers are joined
seuratTreg <- JoinLayers(seuratTreg)

# Perform the FindAllMarkers function and store the results in clusterMarkers
clusterMarkers[[paste0("RNA_", clusterName[["RNA"]])]] <-
  FindAllMarkers(seuratTreg, assay = "RNA")

# Print cluster markers
print("Cluster markers found:")
print(clusterMarkers[[paste0("RNA_", clusterName[["RNA"]])]])

palRNAClusters <-
  big_colorblind_pal(
    n_distinct(seuratTreg@meta.data[[clusterName[["RNA"]]]]),
    shuffle_colors = TRUE,
    drop_yellow = TRUE, drop_black = TRUE) %>%
  setNames(sort(unique(seuratTreg@meta.data[[clusterName[["RNA"]]]])))

# Get the number of distinct RNA clusters
num_clusters <- n_distinct(seuratTreg@meta.data[[clusterName[["RNA"]]]])

# Get the "ggsci::uniform_startrek" palette and adjust it
palRNAClusters <- paletteer_d("khroma::okabeitoblack", n = num_clusters) %>%
  sample() %>%  # Shuffle colors
  .[!grepl("yellow|black", .)] %>%  # Drop yellow and black colors
  setNames(sort(unique(seuratTreg@meta.data[[clusterName[["RNA"]]]])))
```
